description:
No Sugar Added 5 Berry Oatmeal Cups

All the berry goodness of our 5 Berry blend, without the sugar. You will wake up an hour early just looking forward to this very berry blend of juicy, nutrient packed and antioxidant rich oatmeal loaded with blueberries, strawberries, cranberries, blackberries, raspberries, and accented with California almonds and pecans.

What's so modern about Modern Oats?

We start by selecting only the most nutrient and protein rich, non-genetically modified, and certified gluten-free whole rolled oats from smaller, family run farms throughout the upper Midwest of North America.

After the groats are steamed and sized, we then blend with the finest, juiciest, antioxidant rich super fruits, omega 3 rich nuts and seeds, and lightly sweetened with only a touch of the purest cane sugar to craft the most delicious, healthy, modern blends of oatmeal found today.

Healthy, Delicious and Fast

Modern Oats convenient single serving cups make a quick healthy breakfast on the go possible. To prepare Modern Oats oatmeal, simply add boiling water to cover the oats. Let steep for 3 minutes, stir well and enjoy!

ללא סוכר תוספת 5 כוסות שיבולת שועל

כל טובי הגרגרים של תערובת 5 גרגרי יער שלנו, ללא סוכר. אתם תתעוררו שעה מוקדם רק מצפים לתערובת הגרגרים העסיסיסית, ארוזה בחומרים מזינים ונוגדי חמצון עשיר שיבולת שועל טעונה באוכמניות, תותים, חמוציות, פטל, ומודגשת עם שקדים ופקאנים קליפורניה.

מה כל כך מודרני בשיבולת שועל מודרנית?

אנו מתחילים בבחירת שיבולת שועל שלמה מגולגלת ללא גלוטן מחוות קטנות יותר וריצות משפחתיות ברחבי המערב התיכון העליון של צפון אמריקה.

לאחר שהגרונים מאודים וגדולים, אנו משתלבים עם הפירות העסיסיים ביותר, העסיסיים ביותר נוגדי חמצון, אגוזים עשירים באומגה 3 וזרעים עשירים, וממתיקים קלות עם נגיעה של הסוכר הטהור ביותר כדי ליצור את התערובות הטעימות ביותר, הבריאות, המודרניות של שיבולת שועל שנמצאות כיום.

בריא, טעים ומהיר

כוסות שיבולת שועל מודרניות נוחות למנה אחת מכינות ארוחת בוקר בריאה מהירה בדרכים האפשריות. כדי להכין שיבולת שועל מודרנית, פשוט הוסיפו מים רותחים כדי לכסות את שיבולת השועל. תנו לתלול במשך 3 דקות, מערבבים היטב ותיהנו!

No Sugar Added 5 Beeren Haferflocken Tassen

Alle Beeren-Güte unserer 5 Berry Mischung, ohne Zucker. Sie werden eine Stunde früh aufwachen und sich auf diese sehr Beerenmischung aus saftigen, nährstoffreichen und antioxidativen Haferflocken voller Heidelbeeren, Erdbeeren, Preiselbeeren, Brombeeren, Himbeeren und akzentuiert mit kalifornischen Mandeln und Pekannüsen.

Was ist so modern an Modern Oats?

Wir wählen nur den nährstoff- und proteinreichen, nicht gentechnisch veränderten und zertifizierten glutenfreien ganzen Walthafer von kleineren, familiengeführten Betrieben im oberen Mittelwesten Nordamerikas aus.

Nachdem die Groats gedämpft und geglättet sind, mischen wir dann mit den feinsten, saftigsten, antioxidativen, reichen Superfrüchten, Omega-3 reichhaltigen Nüssen und Samen, und leicht gesüßt mit nur einem Hauch von reinstem Rohrzucker, um die köstlichsten, gesunden, modernen Mischungen von Haferflocken herzustellen.

Gesund, köstlich und schnell.

Moderne Oats praktische Einportionstassen machen ein schnelles gesundes Frühstück unterwegs möglich. Um Modern Oats Haferflocken zuzubereiten, fügen Sie einfach kochendes Wasser hinzu, um den Hafer zu bedecken. 3 Minuten ziehen lassen, gut umrühren und genießen!

5 xícaras de aveia sem açúcar adicionadas

Toda a qualidade da nossa mistura de 5 frutas, sem açúcar. Você vai acordar uma hora cedo apenas ansioso para esta mistura de frutos silvestres suculenta, cheia de nutrientes e antioxidantes, cheia de mirtilo, morangos, cranberries, amoras, framboesas e acentuado com amêndoas e nozes da Califórnia.

O que há de tão moderno sobre a aveia moderna?

Começamos selecionando apenas as aveias mais ricas em nutrientes e proteínas, não geneticamente modificadas e certificadas sem glúten de fazendas menores e familiares em todo o centro-oeste da América do Norte.

Depois que os grumos são vaporizados e dimensionados, misturamos com as melhores e mais suculentas e antioxidantes superfrutas, nozes e sementes ricas em ômega 3, e levemente adoçadas com apenas um toque do mais puro açúcar de cana para criar as misturas mais deliciosas, saudáveis e modernas de aveia encontradas hoje.

Saudável, delicioso e rápido

As taças de aveia modernas convenientes para servir individualmente, tornam possível um café da manhã rápido e saudável. Para preparar aveia moderna, basta adicionar água fervente para cobrir a aveia. Deixe passar por 3 minutos, mexa bem e aproveite!

无糖 5 个浆果燕麦杯

我们5种浆果混合物的所有浆果精华,不含糖。 您会早上醒来一个小时，期待这种富含多汁、营养物质和抗氧化剂的燕麦片混合，含有蓝莓、草莓、蔓越莓、黑莓、覆盆子，并辅以加州杏仁和核桃。

现代燕麦是什么现代?

我们首先从北美中西部地区较小的家庭经营农场选择富含营养和蛋白质、非转基因和经过认证的无麸质全卷燕麦。

在蒸煮和定量后,我们将加入最优质、多汁、富含抗氧化剂的超级水果、富含奥米加 3 的坚果和种子,并用少许纯净的蔗糖进行微甜,制作出今天发现的最美味、最健康的现代燕麦混合物。

健康、美味、快速

Modern Oats 便捷的单杯杯让出行中的快速健康早餐成为可能。 要准备现代燕麦片,只需添加沸水即可覆盖燕麦。 浸泡3分钟，搅拌均匀，享受！

不添加糖 5 個漿果燕麥杯

我們 5 漿果混合物的所有莓果口味,不含糖。 您會在一小時早醒來,期待這款非常多汁、營養、富含抗氧化的燕麥片,裡面含有藍莓、草莓、蔓越莓、黑莓、覆盆子,以及添加加州杏仁和山核桃。

Modern Oats有什麼這麼現代?

首先,我們從北美中西部地區較小家庭經營的農場選擇最營養和蛋白質豐富、無基因改良和經認證的無麩質全卷燕麥。

在馬鈴薯蒸煮和尺寸後,我們再混合最優質、多汁、富含抗氧化的超級水果、omega 3 富含堅果和種子,並輕輕添加少許純蔗糖,以製作現今最美味、健康、現代的燕麥混合。

健康、美味、快速

Modern Oats 方便的單杯,讓外出快速健康早餐成為可能。 要準備現代燕麥片,只需加水蓋住燕麥片。 浸泡3分鐘,攪拌均勻並享受!

무설탕 베리 오트밀 컵 5개.

설탕이 함유되지 않은 5 베리 블렌드의 모든 베리 장점. 블루베리, 딸기, 크랜베리, 블랙베리, 라즈베리, 그리고 캘리포니아 아몬드와 피칸으로 강조된 육즙과 영양소가 가득한 항산화 성분이 풍부한 오트밀의 베리 블렌드를 한 시간 일찍 일어날 것입니다.

모던 귀리의 현대적 점은 무엇일까요?

우리는 북미 중서부 전역의 작고 가족이 운영하는 농장에서 가장 영양소가 풍부하고 유전자 변형되지 않은 인증된 글루텐 프리 전체 귀리만을 선택하기 시작합니다.

곡물을 찌고 크기를 조정한 후, 우리는 가장 고급스럽고 육즙이 풍부하며 항산화 성분이 풍부한 슈퍼 과일, 오메가 3 가지 견과류와 씨앗을 섞어 가장 순수한 사탕수수 설탕을 터치하여 가볍게 단맛을 내어 오늘날 가장 맛있고 건강하며 현대적인 오트밀을 만듭니다.

건강하고 맛있으며 빠릅니다.

Modern Oats의 편리한 1인용 컵으로 이동 중에도 빠르고 건강한 아침 식사를 할 수 있습니다. 모던 오트밀을 준비하려면 끓는 물을 추가하여 귀리를 덮으십시오. 3분 동안 가파른 후 잘 저어 즐기세요!

We sourced the finest nuts and seeds along with the water lily seeds and dry toast them to make this hot cereal, which is a nutritional powerhouse for both pregnant and new mothers.

With 8g protein and 9g fiber, this breakfast will also keep you feeling full for longer while providing clean energy to the body. It is also a good source of Vitamin E, iron, potassium, and antioxidants.

FOXNUTS OR WATER LILY SEEDS
These mighty seeds are rich in protein, fiber and antioxidants, and have been used extensively in Ayurvedic diets for new mothers since ancient times. When boiled in milk, they give a delicious mellow flavor and rich texture to the cereal.

CHIA SEEDS
Chia seeds are highly recommended during pregnancy and postpartum being one of the densest nutrition sources. They are rich in omega-3 fatty acids, iron, calcium and magnesium, which are the most vital nutrients for expecting and new mothes.

ALMONDS
Almonds are rich in good fats, protein and many essential nutrients

DATES
Dates have been used during pregnancy and postpartum since hundreds of years due to their nutrient profile, fiber content and delectable natural sweetness. They give a delicious mild sweetness to the cereal while also adding to its nutritional density.

description: Gari is a fine to coarse granular flour of varying texture made from cassava tubers (also called cassava roots) which are cleaned after harvesting, grated, water and starch squeezed out of it, left to ferment and then fried either in palm oil or without palm oil and eaten in a variety of ways. One such way is to drink it, simply add water to the grains stir and there you have it. People often add sugar, groundnut or milk to it – making it a balanced meal/snack. The other way is to cook it in hot water and made into a dough which is eaten with a wide variety of sauces. It is also called gari or gali in some parts of sub-Saharan Africa. It is a rich source of carbohydrate which is good for our body as it is an indigenous source of energy. Gari can be yellow or white depending on what type of oil is used to fry it. Yellow gari contains more nutrients than white gari since it is fried with palm oil which contains vitamins like A and C. Gari is good on its own but it should be eaten with soup to give a balanced diet.

description: High-protein, low-glycemic, nutrient-dense cereal that tastes terrific. It all began at the beginning.... the beginning of Doug Siegel’s day. After years of studying nutrition and the benefits of using organic real foods to create a healthy diet, Doug perfected for himself a cereal of organic oats, goji berries, cacao nibs, cinnamon, and natural sweeteners including coconut palm sugar that friends had started to call “Doug’s Daily Dose.” Doug convinced everyone who visited him to eat his cereal. His friend, Del, enjoyed it so much that she encouraged him to sell it to the world. Says Doug, “I became interested in changing my diet after having some health issues, mostly digestive. I became a protégé of Dr. Jack in New York, which deepened my interest in how food choices can affect health. Then, in 2007, Doug began to experiment with adding more raw food to his diet and noticed his energy levels skyrocketed. An interest in raw foods led him to purchase more food directly from the source: family farms. At the same time, he became very aware of the laws regarding access to food directly from the farm. “Policymakers weren’t always fair or supportive of good health and common sense,” says Doug. “I’m an advocate for fighting government regulation that promotes corporate interest over the health and wellness of the public.” Doug has worked hard to ensure that Vigilant Eats cereal has unadulterated ingredients that work together to make a high-protein, low-glycemic, nutrient-dense cereal that tastes terrific. “It was important this cereal be good for everyone—that’s why it’s certified organic, gluten-free, non-GMO, and vegan,” says Doug. Not only that, Doug wanted Vigilant Eats to be something that could be taken anywhere—from the yoga studio to the soccer field to the office. So, he’s included a spoon and created a formula that lets you add cold water (or milk) to the cereal wherever you are.

description: Great River Organic Milling is located on the upper Mississippi River, in the heart of what is called the Hiawatha Valley. The natural beauty of the area is a constant reminder of the importance of our commitment to organic agriculture. Organic, or sustainable agriculture is more than the avoidance of chemical fertilizers and pesticides. An organic farm strives to protect our environment by building and maintaining healthy soil which, in turn, improves water and air quality. It has been shown that grain and other food crops grown in a healthy soil, resist pests and diseases better than conventionally grown crops and also contain more vital nutrients important to humans. Consuming organic foods promotes the health of individuals and the land on which it was grown. In supporting organic agriculture we promote the cycle of a healthy environment which includes the lives of microorganisms, plants, and humans. Most Great River flour is stone-ground. We believe the natural granite millstones contribute to the quality, taste and nutritional integrity of whole grain flour. Grain flowing into the stones becomes very thin, flat flakes which integrates all parts of the wheat immediately into the flour, allowing the flour to have more flavor. The cooler temperatures that occur during milling with stones allows important enzyme activity to continue. Protein levels are also be maintained. Our stone-ground flours are milled to order, to retain the nutritional value of the flour. Great River is Certified Organic by Quality Assurance International and Kosher approved. Obtaining our certification requires a yearly inspection of our milling facility and records to insure that our products meet industry standards.

Happy Belly Apfel- und Zimt-Instant-Haferflocken-Pakete sind eine köstliche und bequeme Möglichkeit, heißes Frühstücks-Müsli zu genießen. Um es mit heißem Wasser vorzubereiten, leeren Sie das Päckchen in eine Schüssel und fügen Sie bis zu 1/2 Tasse kochendes Wasser hinzu und rühren. Für beste Ergebnisse 1-2 Minuten vor dem Servieren stehen lassen. Zur Zubereitung in der Mikrowelle leeren Sie das Päckchen in eine mikrowellengeeignete Schüssel mit bis zu 2/3 Tasse Wasser oder Milch und rühren. Mikrowellengeeignet für 1 bis 2 Minuten oder bis Haferflocken zu verdicken. Nehmen Sie die heiße Schüssel vorsichtig aus der Mikrowelle, rühren und servieren.

عبوات الشوفان الفوري للتفاح والقرفة من هابي بيلي هي طريقة لذيذة ومريحة للاستمتاع بحبوب الإفطار الساخنة. للتحضير بالماء الساخن، قم بتفريغ العبوة في وعاء وأضف ما يصل إلى 1/2 كوب من الماء المغلي وقم بتحريكه. للحصول على أفضل النتائج، اتركيه لمدة دقيقة إلى دقيقتين قبل التقديم. للتحضير في الميكروويف، قم بتفريغ العبوة في وعاء آمن للاستخدام في الميكروويف مع ما يصل إلى 2/3 كوب من الماء أو الحليب وتحريكه. يتم كشفه في الميكروويف على درجة حرارة عالية لمدة دقيقة إلى دقيقتين أو حتى يبدأ الشوفان في التسميك. قم بإزالة الوعاء الساخن بعناية من الميكروويف، وقم بتحريكه وقديمه.

1971년, Barbara가 회사를 시작했을 때, 베이 지역은 모든 사람들에게 사랑을 표현하고자 하는 욕망으로 가득한 젊은이들과 함께 윙윙윙거리게 되었습니다. 세상은 자신의 길을 만들고 다른 사람들을 새로운 방향으로 바꾸려고 노력하면서 매일 변화했습니다. 바바라(Barbara)는 17살이면서 진짜 음식을 부르고 북부 캘리포니아에 작은 천연 베이커리를 열었습니다. 그녀는 간단한 계획을 가지고 있었습니다—건강에 좋은 음식 맛을 믿을 수 없을 정도로 맛있게 만들었습니다. 건강, 가족 및 주방 테이블에서 좋은 삶의 초석으로 영감을 받은 그녀는 자연이 의도한 대로 통곡물과 귀리를 사용하여 단순하고 현실적으로 유지합니다. 베이커리는 가장 거친 꿈을 뛰어넘어 상점 시작부터 번창하는 도매 사업으로 성장했습니다. 40년 이상 전에 첫 빵을 먹은 이후로 시리얼, 스낵바, 쿠키 및 치즈 퍼프를 포함한 제품으로 성장했습니다. 저희는 가장 정직한 재료로 간단하고 건강하며 맛있는 제품을 만들기 위해 Barbara의 노력을 기울이고 있습니다.

description: Bob's Red Mill Organic Polenta Corn Grits are made using only the finest golden corn for a rich flavor that is sure to please your palate, any meal of the day. Native Americans offered the first settlers in the US bowls of Rockahominie, a dish consisting of ground up corn grain cooked into a creamy mixture. It is believed this corn mixture kept many of the settlers alive during those cold winters. Today, corn grits hold a prominent place in soul food and southern dishes. They are also used as a side or a pairing with dishes containing very heavily spiced ingredients. Grits may be eaten covered in gravy, cheese or butter and salt; or served with seafood, meats or vegetables. Polenta is a dish that has been popular in Italian and other European cuisine, and is now gaining fans in America as well. It is made from coarse ground corn (grits), boiled in water to create a porridge. This can be topped and served immediately for a warm corn side dish. Alternatively, you can spread the porridge in a pan and refrigerate it until it sets. Then the polenta can be cut into squares and baked, grilled or fried. Similar to pasta, cooked polenta is delicious topped with marinara sauce, shredded cheese, or grilled or roasted vegetables. Many gourmet Italian and Mediterranean restaurants feature our polenta. 我们首先从北美中西部地区较小的家庭经营农场选择富含营养和蛋白质、非转基因和经过认证的无麸质全卷燕麦。

모던 귀리의 현대적 점은 무엇일까요?

우리는 북미 중서부 전역의 작고 가족이 운영하는 농장에서 가장 영양소가 풍부하고 유전자 변형되지 않은 인증된 글루텐 프리 전체 귀리만을 선택하기 시작합니다.

건강하고 맛있으며 빠릅니다.

description: Great River Organic Milling is located on the upper Mississippi River, in the heart of what is called the Hiawatha Valley. The natural beauty of the area is a constant reminder of the importance of our commitment to organic agriculture. Organic, or sustainable agriculture is more than the avoidance of chemical fertilizers and pesticides. An organic farm strives to protect our environment by building and maintaining healthy soil which, in turn, improves water and air quality. It has been shown that grain and other food crops grown in a healthy soil, resist pests and diseases better than conventionally grown crops and also contain more vital nutrients important to humans. Consuming organic foods promotes the health of individuals and the land on which it was grown. In supporting organic agriculture we promote the cycle of a healthy environment which includes the lives of microorganisms, plants, and humans. Most Great River flour is stone-ground. We believe the natural granite millstones contribute to the quality, taste and nutritional integrity of whole grain flour. Grain flowing into the stones becomes very thin, flat flakes which integrates all parts of the wheat immediately into the flour, allowing the flour to have more flavor. The cooler temperatures that occur during milling with stones allows important enzyme activity to continue. Protein levels are also be maintained. Our stone-ground flours are milled to order, to retain the nutritional value of the flour. Great River is Certified Organic by Quality Assurance International and Kosher approved. Obtaining our certification requires a yearly inspection of our milling facility and records to insure that our products meet industry standards.

bullet_point: [NUTRITIOUS WHEAT SUBSTITUTE: Organic Kamut is like regular wheat but more nutritious and tasty., WHOLE GRAIN WITH ZINC: Organic Kamut grain is exceptionally rich in zinc, selenium, and magnesium., DELICIOUS HEALTHY GRAIN: Organic Kamut has a nutty flavor and goes well in sweet and savory recipes., EASY TO COOK: Food To Live Organic Kamut flakes cook very fast and don’t need prior preparation., ORGANIC CERTIFIED WHOLE GRAIN: Organic Kamut from Food To Live is 100% non-GMO and toxin-free.]
description:
Centuries ago, a grain known as kamut or Khorasan wheat, was a staple food to the people of Central Asia. Now Organic Kamut from Food To Live helps bring this incredible food back to light. This whole grain is nutritious and very tasty. It fits both sweet and savory dishes, and it will help you enjoy a healthy diet.

Organic kamut is delicious when served with vegetables in savory dishes and just as good when you sweeten it.


Nutritional Benefits of Organic Kamut

Organic kamut is more nutritious than the regular wheat available today. The main difference lies in the amounts of protein and zinc. Overall, it can really be considered one of the most nutrient dense whole grains.

Organic kamut benefits any meal plan, even the one for detox, because aside from fiber and protein, it also gives you a boost of essential nutrients, including:

● Selenium
● Manganese
● Magnesium
● Zinc
● B vitamins


How to Cook

You should soak kamut berries overnight before cooking them at low heat. However, a few hours of pre-soaking will do as well.

When cooking this grain, take 3 parts of water for every part of kamut seeds. Note that you need to put the grain into cold water and bring to a simmer. Then, let it simmer for about 2 hours. At a slow simmer, your kamut wheat should soak up all the water and become tender. The texture of a well-cooked grain will be similar to rice.

Organic Kamut Flakes from Food To Live keep extremely well and don’t have any special storage requirements. It’s a type of dried goods, and thus, fit for long-term food storage.

description:
Need help finding fruits and nuts in nature? There's no better guide than a bear. Want a companion to share their Fruit and Nut Granola, with Non-GMO project verified almonds, raisins, coconut, dried cranberries, pecans and walnuts? You should probably ask a human. We're just going to come out with it. Bears make the decisions around here. They pick out the ingredients, create new flavors and taste-test every batch of granola we make. Nothing goes out the door before it gets their bear stamp of approval. Now you may be thinking, why? Employing wild, unpredictable animals seems like a terrible business plan. Sure, we admit sometimes things can get a little awkward, like when the company picnic is BYOB (bring your own bees). But the truth is, the bears keep us honest. Their instincts always point them to the highest quality foods found in the wild.

¿Necesitas ayuda para encontrar frutas y frutos secos en la naturaleza? No hay mejor guía que un oso. ¿Quieres que un compañero comparta su Granola de Frutas y Nuez, con el proyecto No-OGM verificado almendras, pasas, coco, arándanos secos, nueces y nueces? Probablemente deberías preguntarle a un humano. Sólo vamos a salir con ello. Los osos toman las decisiones por aquí. Seleccionan los ingredientes, crean nuevos sabores y prueban cada lote de granola que hacemos. Nada sale por la puerta antes de que obtenga su sello de aprobación. Ahora puede estar pensando, ¿por qué? Emplear animales salvajes e impredecibles parece un terrible plan de negocios. Claro, admitimos a veces las cosas pueden ponerse un poco incómodo, como cuando el picnic de la empresa es BYOB (traer sus propias abejas). Pero la verdad es que los osos nos mantienen honestos. Sus instintos siempre los apuntan a los alimentos de la más alta calidad que se encuentran en la naturaleza.

זקוקים לעזרה במציאת פירות ואגוזים בטבע? אין מדריך טוב יותר מאשר דוב. רוצים בן לוויה לחלוק את גרנולה הפירות והאגוזים שלהם, עם פרויקט ללא הנדסה גנטית מאומתת, צימוקים, קוקוס, חמוציות יבשות, פקאנים ואגוזי מלך? כדאי שתשאלו בן אדם. אנחנו פשוט הולכים לצאת איתו. דובים מקבלים את ההחלטות כאן. הם בוחרים את המרכיבים, יוצרים טעמים חדשים ומבחנים בכל אצווה של גרנולה שאנו מכינים. שום דבר לא יוצא מהדלת לפני שהוא מקבל חותמת אישור הדוב שלהם. עכשיו אתה אולי חושב, למה? העסקת חיות פראיות ובלתי צפויות נראית כמו תוכנית עסקית נוראית. כמובן, אנו מודים שלפעמים דברים יכולים להיות קצת מביכים, כמו כאשר הפיקניק של החברה הוא BYOB (הביאו את הדבורים שלכם). אבל האמת היא, הדובים שומרים עלינו כנות. האינסטינקטים שלהם תמיד מצביעים עליהם למאכלים באיכות הגבוהה ביותר הנמצאים בטבע.

Brauchen Sie Hilfe beim Auffinden von Früchten und Nüssen in der Natur? Es gibt keinen besseren Leitfaden als einen Bär. Möchten Sie einen Begleiter, der sein Obst- und Nussgranola mit nicht-GVO-Projekt verifizierten Mandeln, Rosinen, Kokosnuss, getrockneten Preiselbeeren, Pekannüsse und Walnüssen teilt? Wahrscheinlich sollten Sie einen Menschen fragen. Wir werden einfach damit herauskommen. Bären treffen hier die Entscheidungen. Sie nehmen die Zutaten heraus, kreieren neue Aromen und testen jede Menge Granola, die wir herstellen. Nichts geht aus der Tür, bevor es seinen Bärenstempel bekommt. Nun denken Sie vielleicht nach, warum? Die Verwendung von wilden, unvorhersehbaren Tieren scheint wie ein schrecklicher Geschäftsplan. Sicher, wir geben zu, dass manchmal Dinge ein wenig umständlich werden können, wie wenn das Firmenpicknick BYOB ist (bringen Sie Ihre eigenen Bienen). 3. Substitute up to ½ cup flakes for flour in quick breads.
4. Replace up to ½ the flour in pancakes with flakes.

description:
Avalanche Swiss Granola

Our Company: Located on the banks of Lake Sarnen in Switzerland, surrounded by mountain peaks and fresh air, Avalanche Swiss Granola is slow baked with care in small batches, reflecting over 60 years of expertise and tradition. We use the finest ingredients and highest quality process to produce for the best possible granola.

Our Process: All of the Avalanche granola is baked in a slow and low process in Switzerland in a 100% Green energy facility that is cleaned daily with only 100% bio-degradable and safe cleaning agents. After the baking process, the granola is packed in a foil pouch and nitrogen flushed. Nitrogen keeps out moisture and oxygen for a crispy and crunchy granola. Avalanche Granola is baked low and slow on a 131ft oven. This baking method bakes more evenly and produces the perfect texture; slower roast brings out more flavors, maintains larger clusters and creates a better taste.

Our Difference: A big difference between most granolas and Avalanche is that we use more oats, seeds, and nuts while competitors use more flour and sugar. Flour and sugar are soft and porous. When milk is poured over the granola it absorbs much faster and becomes soggy. The seeds, nuts and oat flakes in Avalanche help create a better barrier to liquid which lets it retain the crunchy texture for a longer amount of time.

description:
Avalanche Swiss Granola

Our Company: Located on the banks of Lake Sarnen in Switzerland, surrounded by mountain peaks and fresh air, Avalanche Swiss Granola is slow baked with care in small batches, reflecting over 60 years of expertise and tradition. We use the finest ingredients and highest quality process to produce for the best possible granola.

Our Process: All of the Avalanche granola is baked in a slow and low process in Switzerland in a 100% Green energy facility that is cleaned daily with only 100% bio-degradable and safe cleaning agents. After the baking process, the granola is packed in a foil pouch and nitrogen flushed. Nitrogen keeps out moisture and oxygen for a crispy and crunchy granola. Avalanche Granola is baked low and slow on a 131ft oven. This baking method bakes more evenly and produces the perfect texture; slower roast brings out more flavors, maintains larger clusters and creates a better taste.

Our Difference: A big difference between most granolas and Avalanche is that we use more oats, seeds, and nuts while competitors use more flour and sugar. Flour and sugar are soft and porous. When milk is poured over the granola it absorbs much faster and becomes soggy. The seeds, nuts and oat flakes in Avalanche help create a better barrier to liquid which lets it retain the crunchy texture for a longer amount of time.

description:
You Are Now Entering The Gluten Free Zone...

Way back in 2009 (wow time flies), there weren't many cereal options for people who were gluten-free, especially when it came to granola. When my husband gave up gluten, he was disappointed when he couldn't find any gluten-free oat-based granolas on the market. This inspired us to create a delicious line of gluten-free, non-gmo granola. It's all handmade in small batches and contains wholesome ingredients such as ground flax seed and coconut. It's baked at a low temperature to bring out its flavor and crunch. Our granolas are all non-gmo verified, gluten-free certified (GFCO), kosher OU, contain real ingredients and have no artificial colors, flavors, or preservatives.

What's In Your Cereal Bowl?

Cereal is one of the basic household essentials, but do you really trust all of the preservatives found in most products these days? Why not fill your bowl with the artisan flavors of Jessica's Natural Foods granola clusters? Your spoon will probably be as happy as your taste buds!

The Breakfast Club Remedy for Celiacs

Living without gluten does not have to be a flavorless curse or an excuse to not join your friends for breakfast. Jessica's Natural Foods believes people with food allergies should enjoy food that tastes as good or better than their allergen loaded counterparts. Certified gluten free has never tasted better!

Just Add Milk or Enjoy As Snack

No milk (or milk substitute)? No problem! Even without it, Jessica's Natural Foods baked granola makes the perfect snack when you are on-the-go or looking for something to have at the office or in school. Go ahead, treat yourself! Also makes a great gift!

Get the High Quality Breakfast Blend from Jessica's Natural Foods Today!

description: Flahavan’s has been milling oats at the family mill in Kilmacthomas, Co. Waterford for over 200 years. There has been an oats mill at Kilmacthomas since the late 1700's. The power for the mill came from the nearby River Mahon which at one time also powered four other mills. In those days, the mill was used for the contract milling of oats for local farm growers and oat growers. This is where the farmer’s oats were then milled and the milled oatmeal was returned to him. He was charged for this service. At this time, the oatmeal was a heavier type than the Flahavan's "flaked" oatmeal we know today. In 1935 it was decided to expand the mill and to put in an oatflaking facility. Oatflaking produced a finer flake, which is faster to cook. description:
Need help finding fruits and nuts in nature? There's no better guide than a bear. Want a companion to share their Fruit and Nut Granola, with Non-GMO project verified whole grain oats, honey, almonds, coconut, raisins, dried cranberries, pecans, and walnuts? You should probably ask a human. We're just going to come out with it. Bears make the decisions around here. They pick out the ingredients, create new flavors, and taste-test every batch of granola we make. Nothing goes out the door before it gets their bear stamp of approval. Now you may be thinking, why? Employing wild, unpredictable animals seems like a terrible business plan. Sure, we admit sometimes things can get a little awkward, like when the company picnic is BYOB (bring your own bees). But the truth is, the bears keep us honest. Their instincts always point them to the highest quality foods found in the wild.

¿Necesitas ayuda para encontrar frutas y frutos secos en la naturaleza? No hay mejor guía que un oso. ¿Quieres que un compañero comparta su granola de frutas y frutos secos, con el proyecto No-OGM verificado avena integral, miel, almendras, coco, pasas, arándanos secos, nueces, nueces? Probablemente deberías preguntarle a un humano. Sólo vamos a salir con ello. Los osos toman las decisiones por aquí. Seleccionan los ingredientes, crean nuevos sabores y prueban cada lote de granola que hacemos. Nada sale por la puerta antes de que obtenga su sello de aprobación. Ahora puede estar pensando, ¿por qué? Emplear animales salvajes e impredecibles parece un terrible plan de negocios. Claro, admitimos a veces las cosas pueden ponerse un poco incómodo, como cuando el picnic de la empresa es BYOB (traer sus propias abejas). Pero la verdad es que los osos nos mantienen honestos. Sus instintos siempre los apuntan a los alimentos de la más alta calidad que se encuentran en la naturaleza.

זקוקים לעזרה במציאת פירות ואגוזים בטבע? אין מדריך טוב יותר מאשר דוב. רוצים בן לוויה לחלוק את גרנולה הפירות והאגוזים שלהם, עם פרויקט ללא הנדסה גנטית אומתה של דגנים מלאים, דבש, שקדים, קוקוס, צימוקים, חמוציות מיובשות, פקאנים ואגוזי מלך? כדאי שתשאלו בן אדם. אנחנו פשוט הולכים לצאת איתו. דובים מקבלים את ההחלטות כאן. הם בוחרים את המרכיבים, יוצרים טעמים חדשים ומבחנים כל אצווה של גרנולה שאנו מכינים. שום דבר לא יוצא מהדלת לפני שהוא מקבל חותמת אישור הדוב שלהם. עכשיו אתה אולי חושב, למה? העסקת חיות פראיות ובלתי צפויות נראית כמו תוכנית עסקית נוראית. כמובן, אנו מודים שלפעמים דברים יכולים להיות קצת מביכים, כמו כאשר הפיקניק של החברה הוא BYOB (הביאו את הדבורים שלכם). אבל האמת היא, הדובים שומרים עלינו כנות. האינסטינקטים שלהם תמיד מצביעים עליהם למאכלים באיכות הגבוהה ביותר הנמצאים בטבע.

Brauchen Sie Hilfe beim Auffinden von Früchten und Nüssen in der Natur? Es gibt keinen besseren Leitfaden als einen Bär. Möchten Sie einen Begleiter, der sein Obst- und Nussgranola mit nicht-GVO-Projekt verifiziertem Vollkorn-Hafer, Honig, Mandeln, Kokosnuss, Rosinen, getrockneten Preiselbeeren, Pekannüsse und Walnüssen teilt? Wahrscheinlich sollten Sie einen Menschen fragen. Wir werden einfach damit herauskommen. Bären treffen hier die Entscheidungen. Sie nehmen die Zutaten heraus und kreieren neue Aromen und testen jede Menge Granola, die wir herstellen. Nichts geht aus der Tür, bevor es seinen Bärenstempel bekommt. Nun denken Sie vielleicht nach, warum? Die Verwendung von wilden, unvorhersehbaren Tieren scheint wie ein schrecklicher Geschäftsplan. Sicher, wir geben zu, dass manchmal Dinge ein wenig umständlich werden können, wie wenn das Firmenpicknick BYOB ist (bringen Sie Ihre eigenen Bienen). Aber die Wahrheit ist, die Bären halten uns ehrlich. Ihre Instinkte weisen sie immer auf die hochwertigsten Lebensmittel, die in der Wildnis gefunden werden.

هل تحتاج إلى مساعدة في العثور على الفواكه والمكسرات في الطبيعة؟ لا يوجد دليل أفضل من الدب. هل تريد رفيقًا لمشاركة الفواكه والمكسرات مع الشوفان المحبب بالكامل المعتمد من مشروع غير معدّل وراثيًا، والعسل واللوز وجوز الهند والزبيب والتوت الجاف والفول والجوز؟ ربما يجب عليك أن تسأل إنسان. سوف نخرج معها فقط. تتخذ الدببة القرارات هنا فهي تلتقط المكونات وتخلق نكهات جديدة وتختبر كل دفعة من الجرانولا التي نصنعها. لا شيء يخرج من الباب قبل أن يحصل على ختم الموافقة عليه الدب الخاص به. الآن قد تفكر في السبب؟ استخدام حيوانات برية غير متوقعة يبدو وكأنه خطة عمل مروعة. بالتأكيد، نحن نعترف في بعض الأحيان أن الأشياء قد تكون غريبة قليلاً، مثل عندما تكون نزهة الشركة BYOB (أحضر النحل الخاص). ولكن الحقيقة هي أن الدببة تبقينا صادقين. غرائزهم دائمًا توجههم إلى الأطعمة عالية الجودة الموجودة في البرية.

Precisa de ajuda para encontrar frutas e nozes na natureza? Não há guia melhor do que um urso. Quer uma companhia para compartilhar sua granola de frutas e nozes, com o projeto não-OGM verificado aveia, mel, amêndoas, coco, passas, cranberries secos, pecãs e nozes? Você provavelmente deve pedir a um humano. Nós só vamos sair com ele. Os ursos tomam as decisões por aqui. Eles escolhem os ingredientes, criam novos sabores e testam cada lote de granola que fabricamos. Nada sai pela porta antes que ele receba o selo de aprovação do urso. Agora você pode estar pensando, por quê? Empregar animais selvagens e imprevisíveis parece um terrível plano de negócios. Claro, admitimos que às vezes as coisas podem ficar um pouco estranhas, como quando o piquenique da empresa é BYOB (traga suas próprias abelhas). Mas a verdade é que os ursos nos mantêm honestos. Seus instintos sempre os apontam para os alimentos da mais alta qualidade encontrados na natureza.

需要帮助寻找大自然中的水果和坚果? 没有什么比熊更好的向导了。 想要一个伴侣分享他们水果及坚果格兰诺拉麦片,非转基因项目验证全谷物燕麦、蜂蜜、杏仁、椰子、葡萄干、蔓越莓、核桃和核桃吗? 您应该问一个人。 我们只是要想出来的。 熊们在这里做出决定。 他们从原料中挑选,创造新的口味,并对我们生产的每一批燕麦进行口味测试。 在获得熊的批准印章之前,没有什么会出门。 现在您可能会在想,为什么呢? 使用野生、不可预知的动物似乎是一个可怕的商业计划。 当然,我们承认,有时事情会变得有点尴尬,就像公司野餐是 BYOB(带上您自己的蜜蜂)。 但事实是,熊让我们坦诚。 他们的本能始终指出了野生食物的高品质。

需要幫助在大自然中尋找水果和堅果嗎? 沒有比熊更好的指南。 想要一個伴侶分享他們的 Fruit and Nut Granola 燕麥,非轉基因項目驗證的全穀物燕麥、蜂蜜、杏仁、椰子、葡萄乾、乾燥蔓越莓、山核桃和核桃? 你應該問一個人。 我們只是要拿出來。 熊在這裡做出決定。 他們挑選原料,創造新口味,並測試我們生產的每批燕麥片。 沒有什麼東西會飛出門才得到他們的認可。 ​ 現在您可能會想,為什麼呢? 使用野生、不可預測的動物看起來像是一個可怕的商業計劃。 當然,我們承認有時事情可能會有些尷尬,例如當公司野餐是 BYOB (帶上您自己的蜜蜂)。 但事實是,熊熊會讓我們誠實。 他們的本能總是指向他們在野外找到最高品質的食物。 ​

자연에서 과일과 견과류를 찾는 데 도움이 필요하십니까? 곰보다 더 좋은 가이드는 없습니다. GMO 프리 프로젝트 인증 통곡물 귀리, 꿀, 아몬드, 코코넛, 건포도, 말린 크랜베리, 피칸, 호두와 함께 과일과 견과류 그래놀라를 공유하는 동반자가 필요하십니까? 아마 인간에게 물어볼 것입니다. 우리는 단지 그것으로 나올 것입니다. 곰은 여기에서 결정을 내립니다. 그들은 재료를 고르고 새로운 맛을 만들고, 우리가 만드는 모든 그래놀라를 맛 테스트합니다. 곰 승인 스탬프를 받기 전에 문 밖으로 나가는 것은 없습니다. 이제 당신은 생각할 수 있습니다. 왜일까요? 야생, 예측할 수 없는 동물을 고용하는 것은 끔찍한 사업 계획처럼 보입니다. 물론, 회사 피크닉이 BYOB일 때와 같이 때로는 일이 약간 어색해질 수 있다는 점을 인정합니다. 하지만 진실은, 곰이 우리를 정직하게 지킵니다. 그들의 본능은 항상 야생에서 발견되는 최고 품질의 음식을 가리킵니다.

description:
Centuries ago, a grain known as kamut or Khorasan wheat, was a staple food to the people of Central Asia. Now Organic Kamut from Food To Live helps bring this incredible food back to light. This whole grain is nutritious and very tasty. It fits both sweet and savory dishes, and it will help you enjoy a healthy diet.

Organic kamut is delicious when served with vegetables in savory dishes and just as good when you sweeten it.


Nutritional Benefits of Organic Kamut

Organic kamut is more nutritious than the regular wheat available today. The main difference lies in the amounts of protein and zinc. Overall, it can really be considered one of the most nutrient dense whole grains.

Organic kamut benefits any meal plan, even the one for detox, because aside from fiber and protein, it also gives you a boost of essential nutrients, including:

● Selenium
● Manganese
● Magnesium
● Zinc
● B vitamins


How to Cook

You should soak kamut berries overnight before cooking them at low heat. However, a few hours of pre-soaking will do as well.

When cooking this grain, take 3 parts of water for every part of kamut seeds. Note that you need to put the grain into cold water and bring to a simmer. Then, let it simmer for about 2 hours. At a slow simmer, your kamut wheat should soak up all the water and become tender. The texture of a well-cooked grain will be similar to rice.

Organic Kamut Flakes from Food To Live keep extremely well and don’t have any special storage requirements. It’s a type of dried goods, and thus, fit for long-term food storage.

description:
Avalanche Swiss Granola

Our Company: Located on the banks of Lake Sarnen in Switzerland, surrounded by mountain peaks and fresh air, Avalanche Swiss Granola is slow baked with care in small batches, reflecting over 60 years of expertise and tradition. We use the finest ingredients and highest quality process to produce for the best possible granola.

Our Process: All of the Avalanche granola is baked in a slow and low process in Switzerland in a 100% Green energy facility that is cleaned daily with only 100% bio-degradable and safe cleaning agents. After the baking process, the granola is packed in a foil pouch and nitrogen flushed. Nitrogen keeps out moisture and oxygen for a crispy and crunchy granola. Avalanche Granola is baked low and slow on a 131ft oven. This baking method bakes more evenly and produces the perfect texture; slower roast brings out more flavors, maintains larger clusters and creates a better taste.

Our Difference: A big difference between most granolas and Avalanche is that we use more oats, seeds, and nuts while competitors use more flour and sugar. Flour and sugar are soft and porous. When milk is poured over the granola it absorbs much faster and becomes soggy. The seeds, nuts and oat flakes in Avalanche help create a better barrier to liquid which lets it retain the crunchy texture for a longer amount of time.

description:
Organic Steel Cut Oats from Food to Live is made from certified organic whole oat grains, after cleaning them by crushing into small pieces. In this way, Organic Steel Cut Oats are more convenient for cooking various dishes while retaining all the benefits of whole grains.


Nutritional Value

Organic Steel Cut Oats are such a fantastic grain because they are highly nutritious. This product is rich in calcium.

Other essential minerals you can get from Organic Steel Cut Oats are:

* Phosphorus
* Iron
* Copper
* Zinc

Organic Steel Cut Oats are rather filling and high in dietary fiber

Organic Steel Cut Oats definitely make one of the healthiest grain choices. As they taste great in savory and sweet dishes, it’ll be easy to add them to your diet. If you are on a weight management plan, choosing Organic Steel Cut Oats for one of the daily grain servings will boost your energy. Complex carbs and fiber digest gradually, which means you’ll feel full longer, preventing hunger pangs.


How to Cook Organic Steel Cut Oats?

The easiest recipe:

Pour 4 servings of water into the pan, add salt to your own taste and bring the water to a boil. Then add 1 serving of Organic Steel Cut Oats to in boiling water and mix the porridge well. Cook Organic Steel Cut Oats at low temperature stirring constantly for 30 minutes. Your Organic Steel Cut Oats oatmeal is ready! You can add fruits, nuts, cream, milk, various syrups to diversify your oatmeal breakfast.


Organic Steel Cut Oats: Storage Tips

Organic Steel Cut Oats don’t require special storage conditions. Keep them dry and safe in an airtight container. Store your oats away from direct sunlight and heat.

Refrigerating and freezing increases product’s shelf life.

description: Great River Organic Milling is located on the upper Mississippi River, in the heart of what is called the Hiawatha Valley. The natural beauty of the area is a constant reminder of the importance of our commitment to organic agriculture. Organic, or sustainable agriculture is more than the avoidance of chemical fertilizers and pesticides. An organic farm strives to protect our environment by building and maintaining healthy soil which, in turn, improves water and air quality. It has been shown that grain and other food crops grown in a healthy soil, resist pests and diseases better than conventionally grown crops and also contain more vital nutrients important to humans. Consuming organic foods promotes the health of individuals and the land on which it was grown. In supporting organic agriculture we promote the cycle of a healthy environment which includes the lives of microorganisms, plants, and humans. Most Great River flour is stone-ground. We believe the natural granite millstones contribute to the quality, taste and nutritional integrity of whole grain flour. Grain flowing into the stones becomes very thin, flat flakes which integrates all parts of the wheat immediately into the flour, allowing the flour to have more flavor. The cooler temperatures that occur during milling with stones allows important enzyme activity to continue. Protein levels are also be maintained. Our stone-ground flours are milled to order, to retain the nutritional value of the flour. Great River is Certified Organic by Quality Assurance International and Kosher approved. Obtaining our certification requires a yearly inspection of our milling facility and records to insure that our products meet industry standards.

Owner, Stephanie Williams, has always believed in providing from-scratch, all natural meals for her family to promote a healthier lifestyle. After having two children, Stephanie resigned from her job to spend more precious time with them and to create an abundance of Oh-Mazing! moments.



WHY WE EXIST

At Oh-Mazing!, we believe that every person has a purpose. description:
Avalanche Swiss Granola

Our Company: Located on the banks of Lake Sarnen in Switzerland, surrounded by mountain peaks and fresh air, Avalanche Swiss Granola is slow baked with care in small batches, reflecting over 60 years of expertise and tradition. We use the finest ingredients and highest quality process to produce for the best possible granola.

Our Process: All of the Avalanche granola is baked in a slow and low process in Switzerland in a 100% Green energy facility that is cleaned daily with only 100% bio-degradable and safe cleaning agents. After the baking process, the granola is packed in a foil pouch and nitrogen flushed. Nitrogen keeps out moisture and oxygen for a crispy and crunchy granola. Avalanche Granola is baked low and slow on a 131ft oven. This baking method bakes more evenly and produces the perfect texture; slower roast brings out more flavors, maintains larger clusters and creates a better taste.

Our Difference: A big difference between most granolas and Avalanche is that we use more oats, seeds, and nuts while competitors use more flour and sugar. Flour and sugar are soft and porous. When milk is poured over the granola it absorbs much faster and becomes soggy. The seeds, nuts and oat flakes in Avalanche help create a better barrier to liquid which lets it retain the crunchy texture for a longer amount of time.

الشوفان السريع من بيكري أون ماين إلى الطاولة خالٍ من الغلوتين ومعتمد من مشروع غير معدل وراثيًا ونباتي ومصدر من البروتوكول النقي. بروتوكول النقاء هو طريقة تُستخدم لضمان أن الشوفان الخاص بنا خالٍ من الغلوتين وآمن على درجة سيلياك. عندما يتم الحصول على الشوفان من مزارعين بروتوكول النقاء، فقد استوفي متطلبات صارمة لنقاء المنتجات، فضلاً عن تلبية معايير النمو والحصاد والنقل والتخزين والمعالجة والتصنيع في منشأتنا المخصصة الخالية من الغلوتين. من المزرعة إلى مائدتك، اجتازت هذه الشوفان أعلى المعايير. لذا، استمتعي بلذة وراحة البال أثناء استمتاعك أو تناول الشوفان للإفطار أو الخبز. تأسست قصتنا في عام 1992، بدأت كمخبز داخل سوق صغير للأطعمة الطبيعية في شارع رئيسي في غلاستونبري كونيتيكت. لقد اكتشفنا شغفنا لصنع وجبات خفيفة لذيذة خالية من الغلوتين وصديقة للسيليك. نفخر بقدرتنا على صنع الجرانولا وألواح الوجبات الخفيفة ودقيق الشوفان ذي الطعم الجيد (إن لم يكن أفضل) من منافسينا الأقل صحة. نحن نؤمن بأن الجميع يجب أن يكون قادراً على الاستمتاع بوجبة مرضية لا تضحي بالطعم من أجل الصحة. للاستمتاع بوجبة خفيفة ممتلئة ومغذية، وجبة خفيفة تناسب تمامًا أي احتياجات غذائية فردية. تعد بيكري أون ماين بالبساطة وسهولة تناول الوجبات الخفيفة حسب شروط أي شخص.

Bakery On Main农场到餐桌的快速燕麦不含麸质,非转基因项目验证,素食和纯度协议。 纯度协议是一种确保我们的燕麦不含麸质和肠胃安全的方法。 当我们的燕麦来自纯度协议的农民时,它们就满足了产品纯度的严格要求,并通过我们的专用无麸质设施种植、收获、运输、储存、加工和制造标准。 从农场到餐桌,这些燕麦都达到了很高的标准。 因此,在享用早餐或烘焙时尽情享受美味并安心无忧。 成立于 1992 年,我们的故事开始于康涅狄格格拉斯顿伯里主街的小天然食品市场内的面包店。 在这里,我们发现了我们创造美味无麸质和适合胃的早餐和零食食品的热情。 我们很自豪能够制作格兰诺拉麦片,零食棒和燕麦片,比不太健康的竞争对手更好(如果不是更好)一样好的味道。 我们相信每个人都应该能够享受一顿令人满意的餐点,而不会牺牲健康的味道。 尽情享受充满营养的零食,一款完美满足任何个性化饮食需求和需求。 Bakery On Main 承诺以任何人的方式提供简单轻松的饮食和零食。

Bakery On Main의 농장 투 테이블 퀵 귀리는 글루텐 프리, 비 GMO 프로젝트 확인, 비건 및 순도 프로토콜이 공급됩니다. 순도 프로토콜은 귀리가 글루텐이 없고 셀리악에 안전하도록 하는 방법입니다. 당사의 귀리는 순도 프로토콜 농부로부터 공급되면서 제품의 순도에 대한 엄격한 요구 사항을 충족했으며, 글루텐이 없는 전용 시설에서 재배, 수확, 운송, 보관, 가공 및 제조 기준을 충족했습니다. 농장에서 테이블까지 이 귀리는 최고 수준의 기준을 통과했습니다. 아침이나 베이킹을 위해 귀리를 즐기면서 맛있고 마음의 평화를 즐기세요. 1992년에 설립된 저희 스토리는 코네티컷 글라스턴버리의 메인 스트리트에 있는 작은 천연 식품 시장 내부에서 베이커리로 시작되었습니다. 여기서 저희는 맛있는 글루텐 프리 및 셀리악 친화적인 아침 식사와 스낵 음식을 만드는 열정을 발견했습니다. 저희는 덜 건강한 경쟁자보다 맛이 좋은 그래놀라, 스낵바, 오트밀을 만드는 능력에 자부심을 느낍니다. 모든 사람들이 건강을 위해 맛을 희생하지 않는 만족스러운 식사를 즐길 수 있어야 한다는 것이 저희의 믿음입니다. 채워지고 영양이 풍부한 간식에 빠져보세요. 개인화된 식이요법과 필요에 완벽하게 맞는 간식입니다. Bakery On Main 는 누구나 쉽게 먹고 간식을 먹을 수 있도록 약속드립니다.

Grain flowing into the stones becomes very thin, flat flakes which integrates all parts of the wheat immediately into the flour, allowing the flour to have more flavor. The cooler temperatures that occur during milling with stones allows important enzyme activity to continue. Protein levels are also be maintained. Our stone-ground flours are milled to order, to retain the nutritional value of the flour. Great River is Certified Organic by Quality Assurance International and Kosher approved. But the true origins lie in the pages of your grandmothers cookbooks and her old-fashioned recipes that preserve nutrition without compromising taste.

What is it about Nutty Yogi that your grandmother would like the most ? We’re not sure. Maybe she really likes the fact that we get our staples right from the source or she might get patriotic feelings towards our products because they are made right here in India. But what she will definitely love the most is that the Nutty Yogi range of products are easy to use and bursting with nutrition.

At Nutty Yogi we believe that Backward is the new Forward when it comes to food. We go back in time to preserve the good old fashioned goodness and nutrients in the way it was meant to be but add the dash of convenience in the way it’s meant to be eaten today. description:
People have been cultivating oats for millennia. They say that this amazing grain originates from Europe, but today organic oats are grown all over the world. This whole grain is very nutritious and tasty, which means it’s quite popular in the food production industry.


Nutritional Value

Organic Rolled Oats are such a fantastic whole grain because they are highly nutritious.

Some essential minerals you can get from organic oats are:

Phosphorus
Iron
Copper
Zinc

Organic Rolled Oats are rather filling and high in dietary fiber.

This product definitely make one of the healthiest whole grain choices. As they taste great in savory and sweet dishes, it’ll be easy to add them to your diet

It’s possible to use Organic Rolled Oats in oatmeal cookies. Use organic oats for gluten-free baking either by grinding your own flour. Oat flour, organic or not, is a good alternative to wheat as it’s more nutritious. However, it differs in taste, so be sure to try it before substituting white flour in recipes.


Storage Tips

Organic Rolled Oats don’t require special storage conditions. Keep them dry and safe in an airtight container. Store your oats away from direct sunlight and heat.

description:
Gluten-Free Prairie (GFP) is a Montana, woman owned and family operated business built on the foundation of the American dream that anything is possible. In 2005 GFP co-founder Deb and her daughter, Amy were diagnosed with Celiac Disease; an autoimmune disease requiring a lifetime commitment to a gluten-free diet. In 2012 the family followed their passion to bring healthy gluten-free products to the millions of consumers who are avoiding gluten.Gluten-Free Prairie (or GFP as it’s called by the family) strives to create gluten-free food that is not only safe for celiacs and gluten-intolerant people, but also people with no wheat allergies at all. Jeremy Wheaton, the baker in the group, has developed the recipes with flavor in mind. We think you’ll agree that Gluten-Free Prairie products can be enjoyed by just about everyone that likes tasty food. The Gluten-Free Prairie family is Deb and Rick Wheaton, along with their son Jeremy and his wife Jenn. At the heart of the business are higher protein pure gluten-free oats that are grown in dedicated gluten-free fields, harvested on designated gluten-free equipment and packaged in a certified gluten-free facility. There are NO glyphosate sprays used on our oats. GFP is proud of the purity and higher protein in all of their gluten-free oat products creating naturally gluten-free products that everyone can enjoy. GFP is 3rd party gluten-free certified by Celiac Support Association requiring their products to test at 5ppm of below of gluten. The most stringent testing in the industry. Oats are a great source of PROTEIN, fiber and B vitamin as well as a great source of beta glucans which is soluble fiber proven to help lower cholesterol. Gluten Free Prairie is a proud member of Western Sustainability Exchange and Deb is the only food manufacturer on the Board of Directors, Celiac Disease Foundation.

Pradera sin gluten (GFP) es un negocio de Montana, propiedad de una mujer y familiar construido sobre la base del sueño americano de que todo es posible. En 2005, la cofundadora de GFP Deb y su hija, Amy fueron diagnosticadas con Enfermedad Celíaca; una enfermedad autoinmune que requiere un compromiso de por vida con una dieta sin gluten. En 2012, la familia siguió su pasión por traer productos saludables sin gluten a los millones de consumidores que están evitando el gluten.La pradera sin gluten (o GFP como lo llama la familia) se esfuerza por crear alimentos sin gluten que no solo sean seguros para los celíacos y los intolerantes al gluten, sino también para las personas sin alergias al trigo. Jeremy Wheaton, el panadero del grupo, ha desarrollado las recetas con sabor en mente. Creemos que estarás de acuerdo en que los productos de la pradera sin gluten pueden ser disfrutados por casi todos los que les gustan los alimentos sabrosos. La familia de la pradera sin gluten es Deb y Rick Wheaton, junto con su hijo Jeremy y su esposa Jenn. En el centro de la empresa hay avena pura sin gluten con proteínas más altas que se cultivan en campos dedicados sin gluten, que se cosechan en equipos designados sin gluten y se envasan en una instalación certificada sin gluten. No hay aerosoles de glifosato utilizados en nuestra avena. GFP se enorgullece de la pureza y la mayor proteína de todos sus productos de avena sin gluten creando productos naturales sin gluten que todos pueden disfrutar. GFP está certificado sin gluten por Celiac Support Association y requiere que sus productos prueben a 5 ppm de menos gluten. Las pruebas más estrictas de la industria. La avena es una gran fuente de PROTEINA, fibra y vitamina B, así como una gran fuente de beta-glucanos que es fibra soluble probada para ayudar a reducir el colesterol. Gluten Free Prairie es un orgulloso miembro de Western Sustainability Exchange y Deb es el único fabricante de alimentos en el Consejo de Administración, Celiac Disease Foundation.

Prairie ללא גלוטן (GFP) הוא עסק בבעלות מונטנה, נשים וניהול משפחתי הבנוי על בסיס החלום האמריקאי שכל דבר אפשרי. בשנת 2005 מייסדת שותפה דב ובתה, איימי אובחנו עם מחלת הצליאק; מחלה אוטואימונית הדורשת מחויבות לכל החיים לתזונה ללא גלוטן. בשנת 2012 המשפחה עקבה אחר התשוקה שלהם להביא מוצרים בריאים ללא גלוטן למיליוני צרכנים אשר נמנעים מגלוטן. ערבה ללא גלוטן (או GFP כפי שהיא נקראת על ידי המשפחה) שואפת ליצור מזון ללא גלוטן שאינו רק בטוח עבור צליאק ואנשים שאינם סובלניים לגלוטן, אלא גם אנשים ללא אלרגיות בחיטה. Jeremy Wheaton, האופה בקבוצה, פיתח את המתכונים תוך מחשבה על הטעם. אנחנו חושבים שתסכימו שמוצרי Prairie נטולי גלוטן יכולים ליהנות כמעט על כל מי שאוהב אוכל טעים. משפחת הערבה ללא גלוטן היא דב וריק וויטון, יחד עם בנם ג'רמי ואשתו, ג'ן. בלב העסק יש שיבולת שועל טהורה ללא גלוטן גבוהה יותר שגדלים בתחומים ייעודיים ללא גלוטן, נקטפו על ציוד ייעודי ללא גלוטן וארוזים במתקן מוסמך ללא גלוטן. אין תרסיסי גליפוז על שיבולת שועל שלנו. GFP גאה בטוהר ובחלבון גבוה יותר בכל מוצרי שיבולת שועל ללא גלוטן היוצרים מוצרים טבעיים ללא גלוטן שכולם יכולים ליהנות מהם. GFP הוא צד שלישי ללא גלוטן מוסמך על ידי Celiac Support Association המחייב את מוצריהם לבדוק ב- 5ppm מלמטה של גלוטן. הבדיקות המחמירות ביותר בתעשייה. שיבולת שועל הם מקור נהדר של חלבון, סיבים וויטמין B, כמו גם מקור נהדר של גלוקן בטא אשר הוא סיבים מסיסים מוכחים כמסייעים בהורדת הכולסטרול. Prairie ללא גלוטן הוא חבר גאה בהחלפה לקיימות המערבית ודב היא יצרנית המזון היחידה במועצת המנהלים, קרן למחלת הצליאק.

Gluten-Free Prairie (GFP) ist ein Montana-, Frauenbesitz und Familienunternehmen, das auf der Grundlage des amerikanischen Traums basiert, dass alles möglich ist. Im Jahr 2005 wurde die GFP-Mitbegründerin Deb und ihre Tochter Amy mit einer Zöliakis-Krankheit diagnostiziert, eine Autoimmun-Krankheit, die ein lebenslanges Engagement für eine glutenfreie Ernährung erfordert. Im Jahr 2012 folgte die Familie ihrer Leidenschaft, gesunde glutenfreie Produkte für Millionen von Verbrauchern, die Gluten vermeiden. Glutenfreie Prärie (oder GFP, wie es von der Familie genannt wird) ist bestrebt, glutenfreie Lebensmittel zu schaffen, die nicht nur sicher für Zöliaks und glutenunverträgliche, sondern auch Menschen mit keinen Weizenallergien sind. Jeremy Wheaton, der Bäcker der Gruppe, hat die Rezepte mit Blick auf Geschmack entwickelt. Wir glauben, dass Sie zustimmen, dass glutenfreie Prärie-Produkte von nahezu allen genossen werden können, die leckere Speisen mögen. Die glutenfreie Prairie-Familie ist Deb und Rick Wheaton, zusammen mit ihrem Sohn Jeremy und seiner Frau Jenn. Im Mittelpunkt des Unternehmens sind höhere proteinreine glutenfreie Hafer, die auf engagierten glutenfreien Feldern angebaut werden, auf bezeichneten glutenfreien Geräten geerntet und in einer zertifizierten glutenfreien Anlage verpackt. Es werden KEINE Glyphosatsprays auf unserem Hafer verwendet. GFP ist stolz auf die Reinheit und höheres Protein in all ihren glutenfreien Haferprodukten, die natürlich glutenfreie Produkte schaffen, die jeder genießen kann. GFP ist glutenfrei von Drittanbietern zertifiziert von Celiac Support Association, die ihre Produkte auf 5 ppm unter Gluten testen. Die strengsten Tests in der Branche. Haferflocken sind eine großartige Quelle von Protein, Ballaststoffen und B-Vitamin sowie eine großartige Quelle von Beta-Glukanen, die lösliche Faser sind, die nachweislich dazu beitragen, den Cholesterin zu senken. Glutenfreie Prairie ist ein stolzer Mitglied von Western Sustainability Exchange und Deb ist der einzige Lebensmittelhersteller auf der Regisseuren-Foundation, Celiac Disease Foundation.

البراري الخالي من الغلوتين (GFP) هي شركة مونتانا، تملكها وتديرها امرأة، مبنية على أساس الحلم الأمريكي الذي يمكن أن يكون هناك أي شيء. في عام 2005 تم تشخيص إيمي بمرض الإضطرابات الهضمية، وهو مرض آلي يتطلب التزامًا مدى الحياة بنظام غذائي خالٍ من الغلوتين. في عام 2012، تابعت العائلة شغفها بتقديم منتجات صحية خالية من الغلوتين لملايين المستهلكين الذين يتجنبون الجلوتين. براري الخالي من الغلوتين (أو GFP كما تسمى العائلة) تسعى إلى صنع طعام خالٍ من الجلوتين ليس فقط آمنًا للأشخاص الذين يعانون من حساسية القمح على الإطلاق. طورت جيريمي ويتون، الخباز في المجموعة، الوصفات مع وضع النكهة في الاعتبار. نعتقد أنك ستتوافق على أن منتجات براري الخالية من الغلوتين يمكن أن يستمتع بها كل شخص يحب الطعام اللذيذ. عائلة بريري الخالية من الغلوتين هي ديب وريك ويتون، إلى جانب ابنهما جيريمي وزوجته جين. في صميم الأعمال يوجد شوفان نقي خالٍ من البروتين وخالٍ من الغلوتين يتم زراعته في حقول مخصصة خالية من الغلوتين، ويتم حصاده على معدات مخصصة خالية من الغلوتين ومعبأ في منشأة معتمدة خالية من الغلوتين. لا توجد بخاخات جليفوزيت المستخدمة على الشوفان لدينا. تفتخر جي إف بي بالنقاء والبروتين الأعلى في جميع منتجات الشوفان الخالية من الغلوتين، مما يخلق منتجات طبيعية خالية من الغلوتين يمكن للجميع الاستمتاع بها. GFP هو طرف ثالث خالٍ من الجلوتين ومعتمد من جمعية دعم سيلياك التي تتطلب أن تختبر منتجاتها عند 5 جزء في المليون من الجلوتين. الاختبارات الأكثر صرامة في هذا المجال. الشوفان مصدر رائع للبروتين والألياف وفيتامين بي بالإضافة إلى مصدر رائع لجلوكان بيتا الذي أثبت أنه يساعد على تقليل الكوليسترول تُعد البراري الخالية من الغلوتين عضواً فخورًا في التبادل الاستدامة الغربية كما أن ديب هي الشركة المصنعة الوحيدة للطعام في مجلس الإدارة، وهي مؤسسة الأمراض الهضمية.

A Prairie sem glúten (GFP) é uma empresa de Montana, uma empresa familiar construída com base no sonho americano de que tudo é possível. Em 2005, a co-fundadora da GFP, Deb e sua filha, Amy foi diagnosticada com doença celíaca; uma doença autoimune que exige um compromisso vitalício com uma dieta sem glúten. Em 2012, a família seguiu sua paixão por trazer produtos saudáveis sem glúten para os milhões de consumidores que estão evitando glúten. A pradaria sem glúten (ou GFP, como é chamado pela família) se esforça para criar alimentos sem glúten, que não são apenas seguros para pessoas com celíacos e intolerantes de glúten, mas também pessoas sem alergias ao trigo. Jeremy Wheaton, o padeiro do grupo, desenvolveu as receitas com sabor em mente. Acreditamos que você concorda que os produtos da pradaria sem glúten podem ser apreciados por praticamente todos que gostam de comida saborosa. A família Prairie sem glúten é Deb e Rick Wheaton, juntamente com seu filho Jeremy e sua esposa Jenn. No coração do negócio há uma aveia sem glúten pura de proteína que é cultivada em campos dedicados sem glúten, colhida em equipamentos designados sem glúten e embalada em uma instalação certificada sem glúten. Não existem sprays de glifosato usados em nossa aveia. A GFP orgulha-se da pureza e da maior proteína em todos os seus produtos de aveia sem glúten, criando produtos naturalmente sem glúten que todos podem desfrutar. O GFP é certificado por terceiros sem glúten pela Celiac Support Association, exigindo que seus produtos testem em 5 ppm de abaixo de glúten. Os testes mais rigorosos da indústria. A aveia é uma ótima fonte de proteína, fibra e vitamina B, bem como uma ótima fonte de betaglucanos que é uma fibra solúvel comprovada para ajudar a reduzir o colesterol. A Prairie sem glúten é um orgulhoso membro da Western Sustainability Exchange e a Deb é a única fabricante de alimentos no Conselho de Administração, a Fundação Celiac Disease Foundation.

無麩質草原 (GFP) 是一家蒙大拿州女性擁有和家族經營的企業,建立在美國夢寐以求的夢想基礎。 2005 年 GFP 聯合創始人 Deb 和她的女兒,Amy 被診斷出患有乳糜瀉;這是一種自體免疫疾病,需要一輩子致力於無麩質飲食。 2012 年,家庭追隨熱情,為數百萬避免麩質的消費者帶來健康的無麩質產品。無麩質草原 (或家庭稱之為 GFP ) 致力於創造不含麩質的食物,不僅對乳糜瀉和麩質不耐症的人也沒有小麥過敏的人來說是安全的。 小組中的烘焙師Jeremy Wheaton,已開發出具有風味的食譜。 我們認為您一定會同意,幾乎每個人都可以享用無麩質草原產品。 無麩質草原家族是 Deb 和 Rick Wheaton,以及他們的兒子 Jeremy 和妻子 Jenn。 業務的核心是高蛋白純無麩質燕麥,生長於專用無麩質田野,在指定的無麩質設備上收穫,並包裝在經認證的無麩質設施中。 我們的燕麥上沒有使用草甘糖噴霧。 GFP 為其所有無麩質燕麥產品中的純度更高蛋白質而自豪,創造出每個人都可以享受的天然無麩質產品。 GFP 是 Celiac Support Association 的第三方無麩質認證,要求其產品以 5ppm 以下的麩質進行測試。 業界最嚴格的測試。 燕麥是蛋白質、纖維和 B 維他命的絕佳來源,也是 beta 葡聚醣的極佳來源,經證明,可溶性纖維有助於降低膽固醇。 Gluten Free Prairie 是 Western Sustainability Exchange 的自豪成員,Deb 是乳糜瀉基金會董事會中唯一的食品製造商。

无麸质草原(GFP)是一家蒙大拿,女性拥有和家族经营的企业,建立在美国梦的基础上,一切皆有可能。 2005 年,GFP 联合创始人 Deb 和她的女儿,Amy 被诊断出患有针对 Celiac Disease,一种自身免疫疾病,需要终身致力于无麸质饮食。 2012 年,家庭追随了他们的热情,为数百万个避免麸质的消费者带来健康无麸质产品。无麸质草原(或家庭所称的GFP)努力创造无麸质食物,不仅对胃肠道和麸质不耐症的人安全,而且根本没有小麦过敏的人。 本组中的烘焙师 Jeremy Wheaton开发出了食谱。 我们认为您会认同无麸质草原产品几乎适合喜欢美味食物的人使用。 无麸质草原家族是 Deb 和 Rick Wheaton,以及他们的儿子 Jeremy 和他的妻子 Jenn。 企业的核心是高蛋白纯无麸质燕麦,它们生长在专门的无麸质领域,采集于指定的无麸质设备,并包装在经过认证的无麸质设施中。 我们的燕麦上没有使用甘磷酸喷雾。 GFP 的所有无麸质燕麦产品中纯度和高蛋白质感到自豪,创造天然无麸质产品,每个人都可以享受。 GFP 是经 Celiac Support Association 认证的第三方无麸质,要求其产品在5ppm以下的麸质下进行测试。 业内最严格的测试。 燕麦是蛋白质、纤维和B族维生素的极佳来源,也是β-葡聚糖的极佳来源,这种可溶性纤维被证明有助于降低胆固醇。 不含麸质草原是西方可持续发展交易所的荣誉成员,Deb 是 Celiac Disease Foundation 基金会董事会的唯一食品制造商。

글루텐 프리 프레리(GFP)는 여성 소유 및 가족 운영 기업으로 아메리칸 드림의 기초를 바탕으로 제작되었습니다. 2005년 GFP 공동 설립자 뎁과 딸 에이미는 셀리악 질환으로 진단을 받았습니다; 글루텐 프리 식단에 평생 헌신해야 하는 자가 면역 질환. 2012년 가족은 글루텐을 피하는 수백만 명의 소비자에게 건강한 글루텐 프리 제품을 제공하려는 열정을 따랐습니다. 글루텐 프리 프레리(또는 GFP)는 셀리악과 글루텐 불내증성 사람들뿐만 아니라 밀 알레르기가 없는 사람들에게도 안전한 글루텐 프리 음식을 만들기 위해 노력합니다. 그룹의 베이커인 제레미 위튼은 맛을 염두에 두고 레시피를 개발했습니다. 글루텐 프리 프레리 제품은 맛있는 음식을 좋아하는 모든 사람이 즐길 수 있다는 것에 동의할 것입니다. 글루텐 프리 프레리 가족은 뎁과 릭 휘튼이며 아들 제레미와 그의 아내 젠과 함께 합니다. 사업의 핵심은 고단백질의 순수 글루텐 프리 귀리로, 글루텐 프리 전용 시설에서 재배되고 지정된 글루텐 프리 장비로 수확되고 인증된 글루텐 프리 시설에서 포장됩니다. 귀리에 글리포세이트 스프레이를 사용하지 않았습니다. GFP는 글루텐이 없는 귀리 제품의 순도와 높은 단백질을 자랑스럽게 생각하며 모두가 즐길 수 있는 천연 글루텐 프리 제품을 만듭니다. GFP는 Celiac Support Association에서 글루텐 프리 인증을 받은 제3자 글루텐 프리 제품으로 글루텐 아래 5ppm에서 테스트하도록 요구합니다. 업계에서 가장 엄격한 테스트. 귀리는 단백질, 섬유질, 비타민 B의 훌륭한 공급원이며 콜레스테롤을 낮추는 데 도움이 되는 용해성 섬유인 베타 글루칸의 훌륭한 공급원입니다. 글루텐 프리 프레리는 서양 지속 가능성 교환의 자랑스러운 멤버이며 뎁은 이사회의 유일한 식품 제조업체인 셀리악 질병 재단 기업입니다.

عبوات الشوفان الفوري للتفاح والقرفة من هابي بيلي هي طريقة لذيذة ومريحة للاستمتاع بحبوب الإفطار الساخنة. للتحضير بالماء الساخن، قم بتفريغ العبوة في وعاء وأضف ما يصل إلى 1/2 كوب من الماء المغلي وقم بتحريكه. للحصول على أفضل النتائج، اتركيه لمدة دقيقة إلى دقيقتين قبل التقديم. للتحضير في الميكروويف، قم بتفريغ العبوة في وعاء آمن للاستخدام في الميكروويف مع ما يصل إلى 2/3 كوب من الماء أو الحليب وتحريكه. يتم كشفه في الميكروويف على درجة حرارة عالية لمدة دقيقة إلى دقيقتين أو حتى يبدأ الشوفان في التسميك. قم بإزالة الوعاء الساخن بعناية من الميكروويف، وقم بتحريكه وقديمه.

Os pacotes de aveia instantânea Happy Belly maçã e canela são uma maneira deliciosa e conveniente de desfrutar de cereais quentes para o café da manhã. Para preparar com água quente, esvazie o pacote em uma tigela e adicione até 1/2 xícara de água fervente e mexa. Para melhores resultados, deixe repousar 1-2 minutos antes de servir. Para preparar no micro-ondas, esvazie o pacote em uma tigela segura para micro-ondas com até 2/3 xícara de água ou leite e mexa. Descoberto no micro-ondas na altura de 1 a 2 minutos ou até que a aveia comece a engrossar. Remova cuidadosamente a tigela quente do micro-ondas, mexa e sirva.

Happy Belly Apple & Cinnamon 即時燕麥包是享用熱早餐穀物的美味方便方式。 要用熱水準備,請將袋子清空到碗中,再加入多達 1/2 杯開水並攪拌。 為了獲得最佳效果,請在食用前 1-2 分鐘站立。 若要在微波爐中準備,請將袋子清空,放入微波爐安全碗中,最多可放 2/3 杯水或牛奶攪拌。 微波爐可置於高處 1 至 2 分鐘,或直至燕麥開始變厚。 小心地從微波爐中取出熱碗,攪拌並上菜。

Happy Belly 苹果和肉桂即食燕麦包是享用热早餐麦片的美味方便的方式。 用热水准备,将小包放入碗中,并添加最多 1/2 杯沸水并搅拌。 为了获得最佳效果,请在服用前停留 1-2 分钟。 为了在微波炉中准备,请将小包放入微波炉安全碗中,最多喝2/3杯水或牛奶,然后搅拌。 微波炉加热1至2分钟,或直到燕麦开始增稠。 小心地从微波炉中取出热碗,搅拌和盛用。

Happy Belly 애플 & 시나몬 인스턴트 오트밀 패킷은 뜨거운 아침 시리얼을 즐길 수 있는 맛있고 편리한 방법입니다. 뜨거운 물로 준비하려면 그릇에 패킷을 비우고 최대 1/2 컵의 끓는 물을 넣고 저어주세요. 최상의 결과를 얻으려면 서빙하기 전에 1-2분 동안 서 두십시오. 전자레인지를 준비하려면 최대 2/3 컵의 물이나 우유를 넣고 저어 전자레인지 안전 그릇에 패킷을 비웁니다. 전자레인지는 1~2분 동안 높게 덮거나 오트밀이 두껍게 되기 시작할 때까지 덮여 있습니다. 전자레인지에서 뜨거운 그릇을 조심스럽게 꺼내 저어 서빙하십시오.

description:
Bakery On Main’s gluten-free granola is packed with beneficial nutrients and powerful ancient grains. Not only does this granola taste great, it is non-GMO project verified, vegan, and is also an excellent source of ALA (an Omega-3) per serving. Founded in 1992, our story began as a bakery inside a small natural foods market on Main Street in Glastonbury Connecticut. Here we discovered our passion for creating delicious gluten-free and celiac-friendly breakfast and snack foods. We pride ourselves on our ability to craft granola, snack bars, and oatmeal that taste just as good (if not better) than our less healthy competitors. It’s our belief that everyone should be able to enjoy a satisfying meal that doesn’t sacrifice taste for wholesomeness. To indulge in a snack that’s filling and nutritious, a snack that fits perfectly within any individualized dietary wants and needs. Bakery On Main promises simple, effortless eating and snacking, on anybody's terms.

גרנולה ללא גלוטן של Bakery On Main's ארוזה בחומרים מזינים מועילים ודגנים עתיקים חזקים. שילוב של שמונה סוגים טעימים של פירות ואגוזים עם מולטיגרנים ופריכות שעועית, גרנולה זו מושלמת עבור התזת יוגורט או לתוך קערת חלב לארוחת בוקר בריאה. לא רק שהגרנולה הזו טעם נהדר, היא לא מהונדסת גנטית, טבעונית, והיא גם מקור מצוין של ALA (אומגה 3) למנה. הסיפור שלנו נוסד בשנת 1992, החל כמאפייה בתוך שוק מזון טבעי קטן ברחוב הראשי בגלסטונבורי קונטיקט. כאן גילינו את התשוקה שלנו ליצירת מזון טעים ללא גלוטן וחטיפים לארוחת בוקר ללא צליאק. אנו מתגאים ביכולת שלנו לייצר גרנולה, חטיפי חטיף ושיבולת שועל שיש להם טעם טוב (אם לא טוב יותר) מאשר המתחרים הפחות הבריאים שלנו. זו האמונה שלנו שכולם צריכים להיות מסוגלים ליהנות מארוחה מספקת שלא מקריבה טעם למען בריאות. כדי להתפנק בחטיף שממלא ומזין, חטיף שמתאים באופן מושלם לכל צרכי תזונה אישיים. Bakery On Main מבטיחה אכילה וחטיפים פשוטים ללא מאמץ, בתנאים של כל אחד.

Bakery On Main's glutenfreies Granola ist vollgepackt mit nützlichen Nährstoffen und leistungsstarken antiken Körnern. Kombiniert acht köstliche Obst- und Nusssorten mit hochwertigen Multigrain- und Bohnen-Chips, ist dieses Granola perfekt zum Streuen über Joghurt oder in eine Schüssel Milch für ein gesundes Frühstück. Dieses Granola schmeckt nicht nur gut, es ist kein GVO-Projekt verifiziert, vegan und ist auch eine hervorragende Quelle von ALA (ein Omega-3) pro Portion. Gegründet 1992 begann unsere Geschichte als Bäckerei in einem kleinen natürlichen Lebensmittelmarkt auf der Hauptstraße in Glastonbury Connecticut. Hier entdeckten wir unsere Leidenschaft für die Herstellung leckerer glutenfreier und zolliakfreundlicher Frühstücks- und Snack-Lebensmittel. Wir sind stolz auf unsere Fähigkeit, Müsli, Snack-Riegel und Haferflocken zu fertigen, die genauso gut schmecken (wenn nicht besser) als unsere weniger gesunden Konkurrenten. Es ist unsere Überzeugung, dass jeder in der Lage sein sollte, eine befriedigende Mahlzeit zu genießen, die keinen Geschmack für die Gesundheit opfert. Um sich einen füllenden und nahrhaften Snack zu verwöhnen, ist ein Snack, der perfekt in jede individuelle Ernährungswünsche und Bedürfnisse passt. Bakery On Main verspricht einfaches, müheloses Essen und Snacking, zu jedem Kondition.

حبيبات جرانولا بيكري أون ماين الخالية من الغلوتين غنية بالمغذيات المفيدة والحبوب القديمة القوية. يجمع هذا الجرانولا بين ثمانية أنواع لذيذة من الفاكهة والمكسرات مع مقرمشات الحبوب الممتازة، وهو مثالي للرش فوق الزبادي أو في وعاء من الحليب للحصول على إفطار صحي. لا يقتصر طعم الغرانولا على روعة هذا فحسب، بل هو منتج غير معدّل وراثيًا، ونباتي بل هو مصدر ممتاز لأحماض الأوميجا 3 لكل حصة. تأسست قصتنا في عام 1992، بدأت كمخبز داخل سوق صغير للأطعمة الطبيعية في شارع رئيسي في غلاستونبري كونيتيكت. لقد اكتشفنا شغفنا لصنع وجبات خفيفة لذيذة خالية من الغلوتين وصديقة للسيليك. نفخر بقدرتنا على صنع الجرانولا وألواح الوجبات الخفيفة ودقيق الشوفان ذي الطعم الجيد (إن لم يكن أفضل) من منافسينا الأقل صحة. نحن نؤمن بأن الجميع يجب أن يكون قادراً على الاستمتاع بوجبة مرضية لا تضحي بالطعم من أجل الصحة. للاستمتاع بوجبة خفيفة ممتلئة ومغذية، وجبة خفيفة تناسب تمامًا أي احتياجات غذائية فردية. تعد بيكري أون ماين بالبساطة وسهولة تناول الوجبات الخفيفة حسب شروط أي شخص.

A granola sem glúten da Bakery On Main é embalada com nutrientes benéficos e grãos antigos potentes. Combinando oito deliciosos tipos de frutas e nozes com multigrãos premium e crocantes, esta granola é perfeita para espalhar sobre iogurte ou em uma tigela de leite para um café da manhã saudável. Esta granola não apenas tem um ótimo sabor, mas é um projeto não geneticamente modificado, vegano, e também é uma excelente fonte de ALA (um ômega-3) por porção. Fundada em 1992, nossa história começou como uma padaria dentro de um pequeno mercado de alimentos naturais na Main Street, em Glastonbury Connecticut. Aqui descobrimos nossa paixão por criar deliciosos alimentos sem glúten e celíacos para o café da manhã e lanches. Temos orgulho da nossa capacidade de criar granola, barras de lanche e aveia que têm um sabor tão bom (se não melhor) do que nossos concorrentes menos saudáveis. Acreditamos que todos devem ser capazes de desfrutar de uma refeição satisfatória que não sacrifica o sabor pela saúde. Para se deliciar com um lanche cheio e nutritivo, um lanche que se encaixa perfeitamente em qualquer desejo e necessidades dietéticas individualizadas. A Bakery On Main promete comer e lanches simples, sem esforço, em qualquer pessoa.

Bakery On Main 的無麩質燕麥片含有有益營養素和強大的古老穀物。 將八種美味水果和堅果與優質多穀物和豆片相結合,這款燕麥片非常適合撒在優格上或放入一碗牛奶中,以獲得健康的早餐。 這款燕麥片不僅味道很好,而且經過非轉基因項目驗證,素食主義者,而且每份的 ALA (Omega-3) 極佳來源。 創立於 1992 年,我們的故事始於康乃狄克州格拉斯頓伯里主要街的小型天然食品市場。 在這裡,我們發現了我們對於創造美味無麩質和乳糜友好型早餐和零食的熱情。 我們為製作燕麥片、零食棒和燕麥的能力感到自豪,因為我們的產品比健康不佳的競爭對手一樣好(如果不是更好)。 我們相信每個人都應該能夠享受一頓令人滿意的餐點,而不會為了健康而犧牲味道。 ​ 盡情享受充滿營養和營養的零食,這種零食可完美適合任何個性化飲食需求。 ​ Bakery On Main 保證簡單、輕鬆的飲食和零食。

Bakery On Main无麸质格兰诺拉麦片富含有益的营养和强大的古代谷物。 这款格兰诺拉格兰诺拉格兰诺拉麦片结合了8种美味的水果和坚果,以及优质多谷物和豆脆片,非常适合洒在酸奶或牛奶碗里,以获得健康的早餐。 这种格兰诺拉麦片不仅味道很好,而且经过非转基因项目验证,纯素,而且每份都是α-亚麻酸(一种欧米伽3)的极佳来源。 成立于 1992 年,我们的故事开始于康涅狄格格拉斯顿伯里主街的小天然食品市场内的面包店。 在这里,我们发现了我们创造美味无麸质和适合胃的早餐和零食食品的热情。 我们很自豪能够制作格兰诺拉麦片,零食棒和燕麦片,比不太健康的竞争对手更好(如果不是更好)一样好的味道。 我们相信每个人都应该能够享受一顿令人满意的餐点,而不会牺牲健康的味道。 尽情享受充满营养的零食,一款完美满足任何个性化饮食需求和需求。 Bakery On Main 承诺以任何人的方式提供简单轻松的饮食和零食。

Bakery On Main의 글루텐 프리 그래놀라는 유익한 영양소와 강력한 고대 곡물로 가득합니다. 8가지 맛있는 과일과 견과류를 프리미엄 멀티 그레인 및 콩 크리스프와 결합한 이 그래놀라는 요거트 위에 뿌리거나 우유 한 그릇에 담아 건강한 아침 식사를 즐기기에 적합합니다. 이 그래놀라 맛이 좋을 뿐만 아니라 비 GMO 프로젝트 검증 및 비건이며 1회 제공량당 ALA (오메가3)의 훌륭한 공급원이기도 합니다. 1992년에 설립된 저희 스토리는 코네티컷 글라스턴버리의 메인 스트리트에 있는 작은 천연 식품 시장 내부에서 베이커리로 시작되었습니다. 여기서 저희는 맛있는 글루텐 프리 및 셀리악 친화적인 아침 식사와 스낵 음식을 만드는 열정을 발견했습니다. 저희는 덜 건강한 경쟁자보다 맛이 좋은 그래놀라, 스낵바, 오트밀을 만드는 능력에 자부심을 느낍니다. 모든 사람들이 건강을 위해 맛을 희생하지 않는 만족스러운 식사를 즐길 수 있어야 한다는 것이 저희의 믿음입니다. 채워지고 영양이 풍부한 간식에 빠져보세요. 개인화된 식이요법과 필요에 완벽하게 맞는 간식입니다. Bakery On Main 는 누구나 쉽게 먹고 간식을 먹을 수 있도록 약속드립니다.

description: Great River Organic Milling is located on the upper Mississippi River, in the heart of what is called the Hiawatha Valley. The natural beauty of the area is a constant reminder of the importance of our commitment to organic agriculture. Organic, or sustainable agriculture is more than the avoidance of chemical fertilizers and pesticides. An organic farm strives to protect our environment by building and maintaining healthy soil which, in turn, improves water and air quality. It has been shown that grain and other food crops grown in a healthy soil, resist pests and diseases better than conventionally grown crops and also contain more vital nutrients important to humans. Consuming organic foods promotes the health of individuals and the land on which it was grown. In supporting organic agriculture we promote the cycle of a healthy environment which includes the lives of microorganisms, plants, and humans. Most Great River flour is stone-ground. We believe the natural granite millstones contribute to the quality, taste and nutritional integrity of whole grain flour. Grain flowing into the stones becomes very thin, flat flakes which integrates all parts of the wheat immediately into the flour, allowing the flour to have more flavor. The cooler temperatures that occur during milling with stones allows important enzyme activity to continue. Protein levels are also be maintained. Our stone-ground flours are milled to order, to retain the nutritional value of the flour. Great River is Certified Organic by Quality Assurance International and Kosher approved. Obtaining our certification requires a yearly inspection of our milling facility and records to insure that our products meet industry standards.

Sarah’s Original Nut & Seed Granola is a grain-free, paleo-inspired blend of energy packed almonds, pumpkin seeds, organic raisins, cinnamon and vanilla. This delicious mix is naturally gluten & dairy-free.

With Sarah’s Sweet and Savory Snacks, you can feel good about what you eat with snacks that are full of flavor with none of the guilt! Our snacks are designed with nutrition expertise from whole food recipes and use distinctive ingredient combination to create truly flavorful eating experiences.

About Sarah’s Sweet & Savory Snacks
At Sarah’s Snacks, we believe that when your taste buds are satisfied, you feel fuller. Working in a framework of only using simple ingredients, you really have to be good at your craft to make it taste good. We are proud of this new line as it challenged us to push the boundaries on new combinations to achieve the taste and nutritional profile we were looking to achieve.

Sarah’s Snacks emphasizes clean ingredients and spectacular taste. We think you’ll love them because our snacks are:

Full of bold, international flavors
Only 3g of sugar per serving
Made from simple, Non-GMO ingredients
Dairy Free and Gluten Free
Packed with plant based protein

Suggested Usage - Paleo Zucchini Nut Muffins
Ingredients
2 cups Sarah’s Sweet & Savory Snacks Original Nut & Seed Granola
1/2 cup coconut flour
2 1/2 cups shredded zucchini
1/2 cup honey
2 large eggs
1 tsp vanilla extract

Directions
Preheat the oven to 375°. Pulse together granola & coconut flour in a food processor for 10-15 seconds & set aside. In a large bowl beat eggs, honey & extract. Fold in zucchini, add nut mixture & mix until it starts to form a dough-like consistency. Scoop 1/2 cup of the batter into a greased standard-size muffin tin. Batter will fill 12 molds. Bake at 375° for 25-30 minutes. Let cool before serving.

description: Great River Organic Milling is located on the upper Mississippi River, in the heart of what is called the Hiawatha Valley. The natural beauty of the area is a constant reminder of the importance of our commitment to organic agriculture. Organic, or sustainable agriculture is more than the avoidance of chemical fertilizers and pesticides. An organic farm strives to protect our environment by building and maintaining healthy soil which, in turn, improves water and air quality. It has been shown that grain and other food crops grown in a healthy soil, resist pests and diseases better than conventionally grown crops and also contain more vital nutrients important to humans. Consuming organic foods promotes the health of individuals and the land on which it was grown. In supporting organic agriculture we promote the cycle of a healthy environment which includes the lives of microorganisms, plants, and humans. Most Great River flour is stone-ground. We believe the natural granite millstones contribute to the quality, taste and nutritional integrity of whole grain flour. Grain flowing into the stones becomes very thin, flat flakes which integrates all parts of the wheat immediately into the flour, allowing the flour to have more flavor. The cooler temperatures that occur during milling with stones allows important enzyme activity to continue. Protein levels are also be maintained. Our stone-ground flours are milled to order, to retain the nutritional value of the flour. Great River is Certified Organic by Quality Assurance International and Kosher approved. Obtaining our certification requires a yearly inspection of our milling facility and records to insure that our products meet industry standards.

description:
If there's one thing bears can't stop talking about, it's honey. Honey this and honey that. It wasn't even a question if we should make Honey Almond Granola, with Non-GMO project verified whole grain oats, honey, and crunchy almonds delivering 11g of protein per serving, 14% of your daily value. Big surprise, they won't shut up about it. We're just going to come out with it. Bears make the decisions around here. They pick out the ingredients, create new flavors, and taste-test every batch of granola we make. Nothing goes out the door before it gets their bear stamp of approval. Now you may be thinking, why? Employing wild, unpredictable animals seems like a terrible business plan. Sure, we admit sometimes things can get a little awkward, like when the company picnic is BYOB (bring your own bees). But the truth is, the bears keep us honest. Their instincts always point them to the highest quality foods found in the wild.

Si hay algo que los osos no pueden dejar de hablar, es cariño. Cariño, esto y cariño. Ni siquiera era una pregunta si debemos hacer Granola de almendra de miel, con proyecto No-OGM verificado avena integral, miel y almendras crujientes entregando 0.39 oz de proteína por porción, 14% de su valor diario. Una gran sorpresa, no se callarán. Sólo vamos a salir con ello. Los osos toman las decisiones por aquí. Seleccionan los ingredientes, crean nuevos sabores y prueban cada lote de granola que hacemos. Nada sale por la puerta antes de que obtenga su sello de aprobación. Ahora puede estar pensando, ¿por qué? Emplear animales salvajes e impredecibles parece un terrible plan de negocios. Claro, admitimos a veces las cosas pueden ponerse un poco incómodo, como cuando el picnic de la empresa es BYOB (traer sus propias abejas). Pero la verdad es que los osos nos mantienen honestos. Sus instintos siempre los apuntan a los alimentos de la más alta calidad que se encuentran en la naturaleza.

Wenn es eine Sache gibt, die Bären nicht aufhören können, zu sprechen, ist es Honig. Honig das und Honig das. Es war nicht einmal eine Frage, wenn wir Honigmandelgranola herstellen sollten, mit nicht-GVO-Projekt verifizierten Vollkorn-Hafer, Honig und knusprigen Mandeln liefern 11 g Protein pro Portion, 14 % Ihres täglichen Wertes. Eine große Überraschung, sie werden sich nicht schließen. Wir werden einfach damit herauskommen. Bären treffen hier die Entscheidungen. Sie nehmen die Zutaten heraus und kreieren neue Aromen und testen jede Menge Granola, die wir herstellen. Nichts geht aus der Tür, bevor es seinen Bärenstempel bekommt. Nun denken Sie vielleicht nach, warum? Die Verwendung von wilden, unvorhersehbaren Tieren scheint wie ein schrecklicher Geschäftsplan. Sicher, wir geben zu, dass manchmal Dinge ein wenig umständlich werden können, wie wenn das Firmenpicknick BYOB ist (bringen Sie Ihre eigenen Bienen). Aber die Wahrheit ist, die Bären halten uns ehrlich. Ihre Instinkte weisen sie immer auf die hochwertigsten Lebensmittel, die in der Wildnis gefunden werden.

אם יש דבר אחד דובים לא יכולים להפסיק לדבר עליו, זה מותק. דבש זה ודבש זה. זו אפילו לא הייתה שאלה אם היינו צריכים להכין גרנולה שקד דבש, עם פרויקט ללא הנדסה גנטית, שיבולת שועל דגנים מלאים, דבש ושקדים פריכים המספקים 11 גרם חלבון למנה, 14% מהערך היומי שלכם. הפתעה גדולה, הם לא ישתוקו על זה. אנחנו פשוט הולכים לצאת איתו. דובים מקבלים את ההחלטות כאן. הם בוחרים את המרכיבים, יוצרים טעמים חדשים ומבחנים כל אצווה של גרנולה שאנו מכינים. שום דבר לא יוצא מהדלת לפני שהוא מקבל חותמת אישור הדוב שלהם. עכשיו אתה אולי חושב, למה? העסקת חיות פראיות ובלתי צפויות נראית כמו תוכנית עסקית נוראית. כמובן, אנו מודים שלפעמים דברים יכולים להיות קצת מביכים, כמו כאשר הפיקניק של החברה הוא BYOB (הביאו את הדבורים שלכם). אבל האמת היא, הדובים שומרים עלינו כנות. האינסטינקטים שלהם תמיד מצביעים עליהם למאכלים באיכות הגבוהה ביותר הנמצאים בטבע.

إذا كان هناك شيء واحد لا يمكن للدببة التوقف عن التحدث، فهو عسل. اسحبي هذا وعسليه. لم يكن هناك سؤال إذا كان علينا صنع جرانولا العسل واللوز مع الشوفان الكامل المعتمد من مشروع غير معدّل وراثيًا، والعسل واللوز المقرمش، مما يوفر 11 جرام من البروتين لكل حصة، و14% من قيمتك اليومية. مفاجأة كبيرة، لن تنغلق عن ذلك. سوف نخرج معها فقط. تتخذ الدببة القرارات هنا فهي تلتقط المكونات وتخلق نكهات جديدة وتختبر كل دفعة من الجرانولا التي نصنعها. لا شيء يخرج من الباب قبل أن يحصل على ختم الموافقة عليه الدب الخاص به. الآن قد تفكر في السبب؟ استخدام حيوانات برية غير متوقعة يبدو وكأنه خطة عمل مروعة. بالتأكيد، نحن نعترف في بعض الأحيان أن الأشياء قد تكون غريبة قليلاً، مثل عندما تكون نزهة الشركة BYOB (أحضر النحل الخاص). ولكن الحقيقة هي أن الدببة تبقينا صادقين. غرائزهم دائمًا توجههم إلى الأطعمة عالية الجودة الموجودة في البرية.
