description:
Bakery On Main’s farm to table quick oats are USDA Organic, gluten-free, Non-GMO project verified, vegan and purity protocol sourced. Purity protocol is a method used to ensure that our oats are gluten-free and celiac safe. When our oats are sourced from purity protocol farmers, they have met stringent requirements for item purity, as well as meet criteria for growing, harvesting, transport, storage, processing and manufacturing in our dedicated gluten-free facility. From farm to your table, these oats have passed the highest of standards. So, bask in the deliciousness and the peace of mind while you enjoy or oats for breakfast or baking. Founded in 1992, our story began as a bakery inside a small natural foods market on Main Street in Glastonbury Connecticut. Here we discovered our passion for creating delicious gluten-free and celiac-friendly breakfast and snack foods. We pride ourselves on our ability to craft granola, snack bars, and oatmeal that taste just as good (if not better) than our less healthy competitors. It’s our belief that everyone should be able to enjoy a satisfying meal that doesn’t sacrifice taste for wholesomeness. To indulge in a snack that’s filling and nutritious, a snack that fits perfectly within any individualized dietary wants and needs. Bakery On Main promises simple, effortless eating and snacking, on anybody's terms.

שיבולת שועל מהירה של Bakery On Main's farm to Table הן אורגניות באישור משרד החקלאות האמריקאי, ללא גלוטן, פרויקט לא מהונדס גנטית, פרוטוקול טבעוני וטוהר. פרוטוקול טוהר הוא שיטה המשמשת כדי להבטיח כי שיבולת שועל שלנו הם ללא גלוטן ובטוחים לצליאק. כשמקורם בשיבולת שועל שלנו מחקלאים בפרוטוקולים טוהר, הם עמדו בדרישות מחמירות של טוהר פריט, כמו גם עומדים בקריטריונים לגידול, קציר, הובלה, אחסון, עיבוד וייצור במתקן הייעודי שלנו ללא גלוטן. מחווה לשולחן שלכם, שיבולת שועל אלה עברו את הסטנדרטים הגבוהים ביותר. אז, התחממו בטעים ובשלוות הנפש בזמן שאתם נהנים או שיבולת שועל לארוחת בוקר או אפייה. הסיפור שלנו נוסד בשנת 1992, החל כמאפייה בתוך שוק מזון טבעי קטן ברחוב הראשי בגלסטונבורי קונטיקט. כאן גילינו את התשוקה שלנו ליצירת מזון טעים ללא גלוטן וחטיפים לארוחת בוקר ללא צליאק. אנו מתגאים ביכולת שלנו לייצר גרנולה, חטיפי חטיף ושיבולת שועל שיש להם טעם טוב (אם לא טוב יותר) מאשר המתחרים הפחות הבריאים שלנו. זו האמונה שלנו שכולם צריכים להיות מסוגלים ליהנות מארוחה מספקת שלא מקריבה טעם למען בריאות. כדי להתפנק בחטיף שממלא ומזין, חטיף שמתאים באופן מושלם לכל צרכי תזונה אישיים. Bakery On Main מבטיחה אכילה וחטיפים פשוטים ללא מאמץ, בתנאים של כל אחד.

Bakery On Main's Farm to Table Quick Haferflocken sind USDA-zertifiziert, glutenfrei, nicht-GVO-Projekt verifiziert, vegan und Reinheitsprotokoll. Reinheitsprotokoll ist eine Methode, die verwendet wird, um sicherzustellen, dass unser Haferflocken glutenfrei und zöliakisch sicher ist. Wenn unser Hafer von Reinheitsprotokoll-Bauern stammt, haben sie strenge Anforderungen an die Reinheit der Artikel erfüllt und die Kriterien für Anbau, Ernte, Transport, Lagerung, Verarbeitung und Herstellung in unserer engagierten glutenfreien Anlage erfüllen. Vom Bauernhof bis zu Ihrem Tisch, dieser Haferflocken hat die höchsten Standards bestanden. So genießen Sie den Hafer zum Frühstück oder Backen. Gegründet 1992 begann unsere Geschichte als Bäckerei in einem kleinen natürlichen Lebensmittelmarkt auf der Hauptstraße in Glastonbury Connecticut. Hier entdeckten wir unsere Leidenschaft für die Herstellung leckerer glutenfreier und zolliakfreundlicher Frühstücks- und Snack-Lebensmittel. Wir sind stolz auf unsere Fähigkeit, Müsli, Snack-Riegel und Haferflocken zu fertigen, die genauso gut schmecken (wenn nicht besser) als unsere weniger gesunden Konkurrenten. Es ist unsere Überzeugung, dass jeder in der Lage sein sollte, eine befriedigende Mahlzeit zu genießen, die keinen Geschmack für die Gesundheit opfert. Um sich einen füllenden und nahrhaften Snack zu verwöhnen, ist ein Snack, der perfekt in jede individuelle Ernährungswünsche und Bedürfnisse passt. Bakery On Main verspricht einfaches, müheloses Essen und Snacking, zu jedem Kondition.

الشوفان السريع من بيكري أون ماين إلى الطاولة هو منتج عضوي من وزارة الزراعة الأمريكية، خالٍ من الغلوتين، معتمد من مشروع غير معدل وراثيًا، نباتي ونقي. بروتوكول النقاء هو طريقة تُستخدم لضمان أن الشوفان الخاص بنا خالٍ من الغلوتين وآمن على درجة سيلياك. عندما يتم الحصول على الشوفان من مزارعين بروتوكول النقاء، فقد استوفي متطلبات صارمة لنقاء المنتجات، فضلاً عن تلبية معايير النمو والحصاد والنقل والتخزين والمعالجة والتصنيع في منشأتنا المخصصة الخالية من الغلوتين. من المزرعة إلى مائدتك، اجتازت هذه الشوفان أعلى المعايير. لذا، استمتعي بلذة وراحة البال أثناء استمتاعك أو تناول الشوفان للإفطار أو الخبز. تأسست قصتنا في عام 1992، بدأت كمخبز داخل سوق صغير للأطعمة الطبيعية في شارع رئيسي في غلاستونبري كونيتيكت. لقد اكتشفنا شغفنا لصنع وجبات خفيفة لذيذة خالية من الغلوتين وصديقة للسيليك. نفخر بقدرتنا على صنع الجرانولا وألواح الوجبات الخفيفة ودقيق الشوفان ذي الطعم الجيد (إن لم يكن أفضل) من منافسينا الأقل صحة. نحن نؤمن بأن الجميع يجب أن يكون قادراً على الاستمتاع بوجبة مرضية لا تضحي بالطعم من أجل الصحة. للاستمتاع بوجبة خفيفة ممتلئة ومغذية، وجبة خفيفة تناسب تمامًا أي احتياجات غذائية فردية. تعد بيكري أون ماين بالبساطة وسهولة تناول الوجبات الخفيفة حسب شروط أي شخص.

A aveia rápida da Bakery On Main's é orgânica USDA, sem glúten, não OGM, verificada por um projeto vegano e de pureza. O protocolo de pureza é um método usado para garantir que nossa aveia seja livre de glúten e segura celíaca. Quando nossas aveias são provenientes de agricultores de protocolo de pureza, elas atendem aos rigorosos requisitos de pureza do item, bem como atendem a critérios de cultivo, colheita, transporte, armazenamento, processamento e fabricação em nossas instalações dedicadas sem glúten. Da fazenda à sua mesa, esta aveia passou pelos mais altos padrões. Então, aproveite a deliciosidade e a paz de espírito enquanto você desfruta ou aveia no café da manhã ou assando. Fundada em 1992, nossa história começou como uma padaria dentro de um pequeno mercado de alimentos naturais na Main Street, em Glastonbury Connecticut. Aqui descobrimos nossa paixão por criar deliciosos alimentos sem glúten e celíacos para o café da manhã e lanches. Temos orgulho da nossa capacidade de criar granola, barras de lanche e aveia que têm um sabor tão bom (se não melhor) do que nossos concorrentes menos saudáveis. Acreditamos que todos devem ser capazes de desfrutar de uma refeição satisfatória que não sacrifica o sabor pela saúde. Para se deliciar com um lanche cheio e nutritivo, um lanche que se encaixa perfeitamente em qualquer desejo e necessidades dietéticas individualizadas. A Bakery On Main promete comer e lanches simples, sem esforço, em qualquer pessoa.

Bakery On Main 的農場到餐桌快速燕麥是 USDA 有機、無麩質、非轉基因項目驗證、純素食和純度的協議。 Pure 協議是一種確保我們的燕麥無麩質且乳糜瀉安全的方法。 當我們的燕麥來自純度協議農夫時,它們符合對物品純度的嚴格要求,並符合在我們的專用無麩質設施中種植、收穫、運輸、儲存、加工和製造標準。 從農場到餐桌,這些燕麥都通過了最高標準。 因此,當您享受早餐或烘焙時,請沉浸在美味與安心的氛圍。 ​ 創立於 1992 年,我們的故事始於康乃狄克州格拉斯頓伯里主要街的小型天然食品市場。 在這裡,我們發現了我們對於創造美味無麩質和乳糜友好型早餐和零食的熱情。 我們為製作燕麥片、零食棒和燕麥的能力感到自豪,因為我們的產品比健康不佳的競爭對手一樣好(如果不是更好)。 我們相信每個人都應該能夠享受一頓令人滿意的餐點,而不會為了健康而犧牲味道。 ​ 盡情享受充滿營養和營養的零食,這種零食可完美適合任何個性化飲食需求。 ​ Bakery On Main 保證簡單、輕鬆的飲食和零食。

Main农场到餐桌的快速燕麦食品是USDA Organic 认证,不含麸质,非转基因项目验证,纯素食和纯度协议。 纯度协议是一种确保我们的燕麦不含麸质和肠胃安全的方法。 当我们的燕麦来自纯度协议的农民时,它们就满足了产品纯度的严格要求,并通过我们的专用无麸质设施种植、收获、运输、储存、加工和制造标准。 从农场到餐桌,这些燕麦都达到了很高的标准。 因此,在享用早餐或烘焙时尽情享受美味并安心无忧。 成立于 1992 年,我们的故事开始于康涅狄格格拉斯顿伯里主街的小天然食品市场内的面包店。 在这里,我们发现了我们创造美味无麸质和适合胃的早餐和零食食品的热情。 我们很自豪能够制作格兰诺拉麦片,零食棒和燕麦片,比不太健康的竞争对手更好(如果不是更好)一样好的味道。 我们相信每个人都应该能够享受一顿令人满意的餐点,而不会牺牲健康的味道。 尽情享受充满营养的零食,一款完美满足任何个性化饮食需求和需求。 Bakery On Main 承诺以任何人的方式提供简单轻松的饮食和零食。

Bakery On Main의 농장 투 테이블 퀵 오트는 USDA 유기농, 글루텐 프리, 비 GMO 프로젝트 확인, 비건 및 순도 프로토콜 공급입니다. 순도 프로토콜은 귀리가 글루텐이 없고 셀리악에 안전하도록 하는 방법입니다. 당사의 귀리는 순도 프로토콜 농부로부터 공급되면서 제품의 순도에 대한 엄격한 요구 사항을 충족했으며, 글루텐이 없는 전용 시설에서 재배, 수확, 운송, 보관, 가공 및 제조 기준을 충족했습니다. 농장에서 테이블까지 이 귀리는 최고 수준의 기준을 통과했습니다. 아침이나 베이킹을 위해 귀리를 즐기면서 맛있고 마음의 평화를 즐기세요. 1992년에 설립된 저희 스토리는 코네티컷 글라스턴버리의 메인 스트리트에 있는 작은 천연 식품 시장 내부에서 베이커리로 시작되었습니다. 여기서 저희는 맛있는 글루텐 프리 및 셀리악 친화적인 아침 식사와 스낵 음식을 만드는 열정을 발견했습니다. 저희는 덜 건강한 경쟁자보다 맛이 좋은 그래놀라, 스낵바, 오트밀을 만드는 능력에 자부심을 느낍니다. 모든 사람들이 건강을 위해 맛을 희생하지 않는 만족스러운 식사를 즐길 수 있어야 한다는 것이 저희의 믿음입니다. 채워지고 영양이 풍부한 간식에 빠져보세요. 개인화된 식이요법과 필요에 완벽하게 맞는 간식입니다. Bakery On Main 는 누구나 쉽게 먹고 간식을 먹을 수 있도록 약속드립니다.

description: Organic Oats Nutritional Value Organic oat groats are such a fantastic whole grain because they are highly nutritious. Other essential minerals you can get from organic oats are: Phosphorus Iron Copper Zinc Organic oat groats are rather filling and high in dietary fiber. One serving (¼ cup) of the grain provides a bit over 4 grams of fiber and 150 calories. This amount also gives you about 26 grams of carbs and less than a gram of fat and sugar. Organic oats definitely make one of the healthiest whole grain choices. As they taste great in savory and sweet dishes, it’ll be easy to add them to your diet. If you are on a weight management plan, choosing organic whole oats for one of the daily grain servings will boost your energy. Complex carbs and fiber digest gradually, which means you’ll feel full longer. Is Organic Oat Cereal Good for You? Oat groats, organic especially, are very good for you because they fuel your body with essential nutrients. Due to their high nutritional value (compared to other whole grains) and fiber, in particular, they make a heart-friendly food. As they digest slowly and gradually, organic oats don’t cause your glucose levels to spike dangerously. They also boost your body’s natural defenses thanks to beta-glucan. Oats as we know them today originate from the wild red oat, a plant with origins in Asia. Originally cultivated for medicinal purposes, they were used as animal feed for a long time before humans deemed them fit for consumption. Oats helped fuel the civil wars in Scotland and have deep roots in Great Britain, Germany and Scandinavia. Today oats are widely accepted as nutritional powerhouses for dietary fiber and protein. Oats contain a special type of fiber that is especially good for the reduction of cholesterol called beta-glucan. Beta-gleans also aid in the support of the immune system and can help regulate blood sugar. They are also wonderful for soothing irritated skin when used in baths. Our Organic Quick Cooking Oats make a delicious and healthy instant oxea alternative to the little packets other brands offer (those being loaded with preservatives and sugar). La avena ayudó a alimentar las guerras civiles en Escocia y tiene raíces profundas en Gran Bretaña, Alemania y Escandinavia. Hoy la avena es ampliamente aceptada como las potencias nutricionales para la fibra dietética y la proteína. La avena contiene un tipo especial de fibra que es especialmente bueno para la reducción del colesterol llamado beta-glucano. Los beta-gleans también ayudan en el apoyo del sistema inmunológico y pueden ayudar a regular el azúcar en la sangre. También son maravillosos para calmar la piel irritada cuando se usan en baños. Bobs Red Mill Bio-Schnellkochtopf, gerollter Haferflocken, 900 ml, 4 Stück pro Packung. Bobs Red Mill Bio-Schnellkochen Roll-Hafer sind völlig natürlich und nicht vorgekocht wie Sofort-Hafer. Sie sind frisch gemahlen aus hochwertigem Bio-Haferflocken, das überall erhältlich ist. Diese Haferflocken sind dünner als herkömmlicher Haferflocken, um die Garzeit zu verkürzen. Haferflocken, wie wir sie heute kennen, stammen aus dem wilden Rothafer, einer Pflanze mit Ursprung in Asien. Ursprünglich für medizinische Zwecke kultiviert, wurden sie lange als Tierfutter eingesetzt, bevor der Mensch sie für den Verzehr geeignet hatte. Haferflocken haben dazu geholfen, die Bürgerkriege in Schottland zu tanken und haben tiefe Wurzeln in Großbritannien, Deutschland und Skandinavien. Heute werden Haferflocken weithin als Nährstoffkraftwerke für Ballaststoffe und Eiweiß akzeptiert. Haferflocken enthalten eine spezielle Art von Ballaststoffen, die besonders gut für die Reduzierung von Cholesterin namens Beta-Glucan ist. Beta-Gleans unterstützen auch das Immunsystem und können dabei helfen, den Blutzucker zu regulieren. Sie sind auch wunderbar zur Beruhigung gereizter Haut bei der Verwendung in Bädern. Unsere Bio-Schnellkocht-Hafer sind eine köstliche und gesunde Instant-Oxea-Alternative zu den kleinen Päckchen, die andere Marken anbieten (solche, die mit Konservierungsstoffen und Zucker gefüllt sind). description:
Avalanche Swiss Granola

Our Company: Located on the banks of Lake Sarnen in Switzerland, surrounded by mountain peaks and fresh air, Avalanche Swiss Granola is slow baked with care in small batches, reflecting over 60 years of expertise and tradition. We use the finest ingredients and highest quality process to produce for the best possible granola.

Our Process: All of the Avalanche granola is baked in a slow and low process in Switzerland in a 100% Green energy facility that is cleaned daily with only 100% bio-degradable and safe cleaning agents. After the baking process, the granola is packed in a foil pouch and nitrogen flushed. Nitrogen keeps out moisture and oxygen for a crispy and crunchy granola. Avalanche Granola is baked low and slow on a 131ft oven. This baking method bakes more evenly and produces the perfect texture; slower roast brings out more flavors, maintains larger clusters and creates a better taste.

Our Difference: A big difference between most granolas and Avalanche is that we use more oats, seeds, and nuts while competitors use more flour and sugar. Flour and sugar are soft and porous. When milk is poured over the granola it absorbs much faster and becomes soggy. The seeds, nuts and oat flakes in Avalanche help create a better barrier to liquid which lets it retain the crunchy texture for a longer amount of time.

description: Great River Organic Milling is located on the upper Mississippi River, in the heart of what is called the Hiawatha Valley. The natural beauty of the area is a constant reminder of the importance of our commitment to organic agriculture. Organic, or sustainable agriculture is more than the avoidance of chemical fertilizers and pesticides. An organic farm strives to protect our environment by building and maintaining healthy soil which, in turn, improves water and air quality. It has been shown that grain and other food crops grown in a healthy soil, resist pests and diseases better than conventionally grown crops and also contain more vital nutrients important to humans. Consuming organic foods promotes the health of individuals and the land on which it was grown. In supporting organic agriculture we promote the cycle of a healthy environment which includes the lives of microorganisms, plants, and humans. Most Great River flour is stone-ground. We believe the natural granite millstones contribute to the quality, taste and nutritional integrity of whole grain flour. Grain flowing into the stones becomes very thin, flat flakes which integrates all parts of the wheat immediately into the flour, allowing the flour to have more flavor. The cooler temperatures that occur during milling with stones allows important enzyme activity to continue. Protein levels are also be maintained. Our stone-ground flours are milled to order, to retain the nutritional value of the flour. Great River is Certified Organic by Quality Assurance International and Kosher approved. Obtaining our certification requires a yearly inspection of our milling facility and records to insure that our products meet industry standards.

description: Great River Organic Milling is located on the upper Mississippi River, in the heart of what is called the Hiawatha Valley. The natural beauty of the area is a constant reminder of the importance of our commitment to organic agriculture. Organic, or sustainable agriculture is more than the avoidance of chemical fertilizers and pesticides. An organic farm strives to protect our environment by building and maintaining healthy soil which, in turn, improves water and air quality. It has been shown that grain and other food crops grown in a healthy soil, resist pests and diseases better than conventionally grown crops and also contain more vital nutrients important to humans. Consuming organic foods promotes the health of individuals and the land on which it was grown. In supporting organic agriculture we promote the cycle of a healthy environment which includes the lives of microorganisms, plants, and humans. Most Great River flour is stone-ground. We believe the natural granite millstones contribute to the quality, taste and nutritional integrity of whole grain flour. Grain flowing into the stones becomes very thin, flat flakes which integrates all parts of the wheat immediately into the flour, allowing the flour to have more flavor. The cooler temperatures that occur during milling with stones allows important enzyme activity to continue. Protein levels are also be maintained. Our stone-ground flours are milled to order, to retain the nutritional value of the flour. Great River is Certified Organic by Quality Assurance International and Kosher approved. Obtaining our certification requires a yearly inspection of our milling facility and records to insure that our products meet industry standards.

description:
Centuries ago, a grain known as kamut or Khorasan wheat, was a staple food to the people of Central Asia. Now Organic Kamut from Food To Live helps bring this incredible food back to light. This whole grain is nutritious and very tasty. It fits both sweet and savory dishes, and it will help you enjoy a healthy diet.

Organic kamut is delicious when served with vegetables in savory dishes and just as good when you sweeten it.


Nutritional Benefits of Organic Kamut

Organic kamut is more nutritious than the regular wheat available today. The main difference lies in the amounts of protein and zinc. Overall, it can really be considered one of the most nutrient dense whole grains.

Organic kamut benefits any meal plan, even the one for detox, because aside from fiber and protein, it also gives you a boost of essential nutrients, including:

● Selenium
● Manganese
● Magnesium
● Zinc
● B vitamins


How to Cook

You should soak kamut berries overnight before cooking them at low heat. However, a few hours of pre-soaking will do as well.

When cooking this grain, take 3 parts of water for every part of kamut seeds. Note that you need to put the grain into cold water and bring to a simmer. Then, let it simmer for about 2 hours. At a slow simmer, your kamut wheat should soak up all the water and become tender. The texture of a well-cooked grain will be similar to rice.

Organic Kamut Flakes from Food To Live keep extremely well and don’t have any special storage requirements. It’s a type of dried goods, and thus, fit for long-term food storage.

description: Great River Organic Milling is located on the upper Mississippi River, in the heart of what is called the Hiawatha Valley. The natural beauty of the area is a constant reminder of the importance of our commitment to organic agriculture. Organic, or sustainable agriculture is more than the avoidance of chemical fertilizers and pesticides. An organic farm strives to protect our environment by building and maintaining healthy soil which, in turn, improves water and air quality. It has been shown that grain and other food crops grown in a healthy soil, resist pests and diseases better than conventionally grown crops and also contain more vital nutrients important to humans. Consuming organic foods promotes the health of individuals and the land on which it was grown. In supporting organic agriculture we promote the cycle of a healthy environment which includes the lives of microorganisms, plants, and humans. Most Great River flour is stone-ground. We believe the natural granite millstones contribute to the quality, taste and nutritional integrity of whole grain flour. Grain flowing into the stones becomes very thin, flat flakes which integrates all parts of the wheat immediately into the flour, allowing the flour to have more flavor. The cooler temperatures that occur during milling with stones allows important enzyme activity to continue. Protein levels are also be maintained. Our stone-ground flours are milled to order, to retain the nutritional value of the flour. Great River is Certified Organic by Quality Assurance International and Kosher approved. Obtaining our certification requires a yearly inspection of our milling facility and records to insure that our products meet industry standards.

description:
Avalanche Swiss Granola

Our Company: Located on the banks of Lake Sarnen in Switzerland, surrounded by mountain peaks and fresh air, Avalanche Swiss Granola is slow baked with care in small batches, reflecting over 60 years of expertise and tradition. We use the finest ingredients and highest quality process to produce for the best possible granola.

Our Process: All of the Avalanche granola is baked in a slow and low process in Switzerland in a 100% Green energy facility that is cleaned daily with only 100% bio-degradable and safe cleaning agents. After the baking process, the granola is packed in a foil pouch and nitrogen flushed. Nitrogen keeps out moisture and oxygen for a crispy and crunchy granola. Avalanche Granola is baked low and slow on a 131ft oven. This baking method bakes more evenly and produces the perfect texture; slower roast brings out more flavors, maintains larger clusters and creates a better taste.

Our Difference: A big difference between most granolas and Avalanche is that we use more oats, seeds, and nuts while competitors use more flour and sugar. Flour and sugar are soft and porous. When milk is poured over the granola it absorbs much faster and becomes soggy. The seeds, nuts and oat flakes in Avalanche help create a better barrier to liquid which lets it retain the crunchy texture for a longer amount of time.

description:
Centuries ago, a grain known as kamut or Khorasan wheat, was a staple food to the people of Central Asia. Now Organic Kamut from Food To Live helps bring this incredible food back to light. This whole grain is nutritious and very tasty. It fits both sweet and savory dishes, and it will help you enjoy a healthy diet.

Organic kamut is delicious when served with vegetables in savory dishes and just as good when you sweeten it.


Nutritional Benefits of Organic Kamut

Organic kamut is more nutritious than the regular wheat available today. The main difference lies in the amounts of protein and zinc. Overall, it can really be considered one of the most nutrient dense whole grains.

Organic kamut benefits any meal plan, even the one for detox, because aside from fiber and protein, it also gives you a boost of essential nutrients, including:

● Selenium
● Manganese
● Magnesium
● Zinc
● B vitamins


How to Cook

You should soak kamut berries overnight before cooking them at low heat. However, a few hours of pre-soaking will do as well.

When cooking this grain, take 3 parts of water for every part of kamut seeds. Note that you need to put the grain into cold water and bring to a simmer. Then, let it simmer for about 2 hours. At a slow simmer, your kamut wheat should soak up all the water and become tender. The texture of a well-cooked grain will be similar to rice.

Organic Kamut Flakes from Food To Live keep extremely well and don’t have any special storage requirements. It’s a type of dried goods, and thus, fit for long-term food storage.

bullet_point: [WHOLE GRAIN GOODNESS: Our Blueberry and Hazelnut Cup features premium Pacific hazelnuts and real blueberries, as well as whole grain oats, flaxseed and chia, GLUTEN FREE: To assure the integrity of our gluten free products, we’ve built a separate 100% gluten free facility and batch test in our quality control laboratory using an ELISA Gluten Assay test, NON-GMO: Non-GMO Project Verified; we’ve always been committed to sourcing raw materials that are not modified through genetic engineering, EXCELLENT SOURCE OF FIBER: One serving provides 29% of your daily value of fiber, an important nutrient, BOB'S RED MILL: Make folks a little happier: it’s the idea that keeps our stone mills grinding to fill every bag with wholesome goodness]
description:
Wholesome, nutritious, whole-grain breakfast just became even quicker and easier! Here at Bob's Red Mill, we know that Food is Fuel(R), so this on-the-go hot cereal is packed with 3 of our favorite styles of gluten free oats, beneficial flax and chia seeds, and just a touch of salt for flavor. Here in the Pacific Northwest where our World Headquarters are, we love and take pride in our local hazelnuts and blueberries, so we made this special cup to share our culture across the nation and beyond. Prepare with hot water or microwave it - either way, it's ready in just 3 minutes!

Gesunderes, nahrhaftes Vollkornfrühstück wurde jetzt noch schneller und einfacher. Hier bei Bob's Red Mill, wissen wir, dass Essen Brennstoff ist (R), also ist dieses heiße Getreide für unterwegs vollgepackt mit 3 unserer beliebtesten Stile von glutenfreiem Hafer, nützlichem Lein- und Chia-Samen und nur einem Hauch von Salz für Geschmack. Hier im pazifischen Nordwesten, wo unser weltweiter Hauptsitz ist, lieben und sind stolz auf unsere lokalen Haselnüsse und Heidelbeeren. Daher haben wir diesen besonderen Becher gemacht, um unsere Kultur in der Nation und darüber hinaus zu teilen. Bereiten Sie es mit heißem Wasser oder in der Mikrowelle vor - so wie immer, es ist in nur 3 Minuten fertig!

ארוחת בוקר בריאה, מזינה, גרגרים מלאים פשוט הפכה אפילו מהירה וקלה יותר! כאן ב-Red Mill, אנחנו יודעים שאוכל הוא דלק(R), אז הדגנים החמים האלה בדרכים ארוזים ב-3 מהסגנונות האהובים עלינו של שיבולת שועל ללא גלוטן, זרעי פשתן וצ'יה מועילים, ופשוט נגיעה של מלח לטעם. כאן בצפון מערב האוקיאנוס השקט שבו נמצאת מפקדת העולם שלנו, אנחנו אוהבים ומתגאים באגוזי לוז ובאוכמניות המקומיים שלנו, אז ייצרנו את הכוס המיוחדת הזו כדי לחלוק את התרבות שלנו ברחבי האומה ומעבר. הכינו עם מים חמים או במיקרוגל - בכל מקרה, הוא מוכן תוך 3 דקות בלבד!

أصبح الإفطار الصحي والمغذي والمحبب بالكامل أسرع وأسهل. هنا في بوبس ريد ميل نعلم أن الطعام هو فيول (R)، لذا فإن هذه الحبوب الساخنة أثناء التنقل معبأة بثلاثة أنماط مفضلة لدينا من الشوفان الخالي من الغلوتين والكتان وبذور الشيا المفيدة، ولمسة من الملح للنكهة. هنا في شمال غرب المحيط الهادئ حيث يقع مقرنا العالمي في شمال غرب المحيط الهادئ نحن نحب ونفخر به البندق والتوت البري، لذلك صنعنا هذا الكوب الخاص لمشاركة ثقافتنا في جميع أنحاء البلاد وما بعده. جهزي بالماء الساخن أو الميكروويف - في كلتا الحالتين، سيكون جاهزًا في 3 دقائق فقط!

O café da manhã atacado, nutritivo, de flor integral ficou ainda mais rápido e fácil! Aqui na Bob's Red Mill, sabemos que Food is Fuel(R), então este cereal quente em movimento está embalado com 3 dos nossos estilos favoritos de aveia sem glúten, sementes benéficas de linhaça e chia, e apenas um toque de sal para sabor. Aqui no noroeste do Pacífico, onde está a nossa sede mundial, amamos e nos orgulhamos de nossas avelãs e mirtilo locais, então fizemos este copo especial para compartilhar nossa cultura em todo o país e além. Prepare com água quente ou micro-ondas – de qualquer maneira, está pronto em apenas 3 minutos!

批發、營養、全穀物早餐變得更快、更輕鬆! 在 Bob's Red Mill,我們知道食物是燃料(R),所以這款隨身熱麥片包裝有 3 種我們最喜愛的無麩質燕麥、有益的亞麻和奇異籽,只需一點鹽味。 在太平洋西北部,我們的世界總部所在地,我們熱愛當地的榛子和藍莓,並為此而自豪,因此我們製作了這個特殊的杯子來在全國及其他地區分享我們的文化。 用熱水或微波爐做準備 - 無論哪種方式,只需 3 分鐘即可完成!

全谷物早餐变得更快,更容易! 在 Bob's Red Mill,我们知道食物是燃料(R),所以这款便携式热麦片装有 3 种最受欢迎的无麸质燕麦、有益亚麻和奇亚籽,只是一点盐味。 在太平洋西北地区,我们世界总部所在地,我们喜欢并为当地的榛子和蓝莓感到自豪,所以我们制作了这个特殊的杯子,在全国和其他地区分享我们的文化。 用热水或微波炉准备 - 无论哪种方式,只需 3 分钟即可完成!

건강하고, 영양이 풍부한 통곡물 아침 식사가 더욱 빠르고 쉬워졌습니다. Bob's Red Mill에서는 Food is Fuel(R)이라는 것을 알고 있습니다. 따라서 이 휴대용 핫시리얼에는 우리가 가장 좋아하는 글루텐 프리 귀리, 유익한 아마 및 치아 씨앗 3가지 스타일, 풍미에 대한 소금 한 터치로 가득합니다. 세계 본사가 있는 태평양 북서부에서 우리는 지역 헤이즐넛과 블루베리를 사랑하고 자부심을 가지고 있기 때문에 전국과 그 이상으로 문화를 나누기 위해 이 특별한 컵을 만들었습니다. 뜨거운 물이나 전자레인지로 준비하세요 - 어느 쪽이든 3분 만에 준비됩니다!
